About A1

There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks that are not AI-native. Our mission is to build a proactive smart assistant for everyday users to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal prompting.

Our product focuses on achieving high reliability for long-running workflows, persistent context, and real-world task completion. The system must handle multi-step reasoning, interact with external tools, and remain reliable despite non-deterministic model behavior. Our objective is to help users complete tasks daily enjoyable with over ~90%* reduced time.

About the Role

As an LLM Application Engineer, you will build the intelligence layer that powers A1's AI experiences.

You will work at the intersection of LLMs, software engineering, and product - designing agent workflows, improving model behaviour, and turning AI capabilities into reliable user experiences.

You will own problems end-to-end, from understanding user needs, designing Agentic workflows, integrating models and tools, building evaluation system and continuously improving AI behaviour in production.

Focus

  • Build and ship LLM-powered applications and AI agent workflows

  • Design systems for reasoning, planning, memory, tool uuse and multi-step execution

  • Build reliable orchestration pipelines that turn probabilistic model outputs into predictable, observable, and safe actions

  • Integrate LLMs with APIs, databases, search, internal services, and external tools.

  • Develop prompting, context engineering, structured outputs, tool-calling, and other techniques to improve model behaviour

  • Build evaluation frameworks and datasets to measure AI quality, reliability, and regressions

  • Debug AI systems across the entire stack—from model behaviour and prompts to orchestration, backend services, and product UX

  • Optimise AI systems for quality, latency, and cost

  • Work closely with product and engineering teams to turn ambiguous product problems into working AI solutions

About A1M

A1M Solutions is a woman-owned small business driven by the aspiration to provide value to our customers, employees, partners, and community while remaining aligned to our guiding principles of foundational values, deliberate focus, and empathetic connection.

A1M’s mission is to preserve and improve government healthcare programs that are lifelines for underserved people in the United States, including people in poverty, elderly people, members of ethnic and racial minorities, immigrants, and refugees. We look for projects with nation-wide impact at the intersection of policy, data, and user experience design.

Besides building useful and usable digital services, A1M helps teams improve their agile, user-centered design practices – or helps them get started. Our goal is not just to build sustainable public services, but also to leave our teaming partners and customers more skilled and more confident in the future.

Technology Delivery at A1M

Product Managers report into the Product Practice at A1M. They help teams execute on a vision, and craft a project strategy. They work in cross-functional, cross-organizational teams, often with policy experts and specialists as well as coordinating with technical teams.

Product management in government involves weaving inputs from stakeholders, policy domain experts, users, and technical partners into a unified path forward. This is particularly true for the lifeline government healthcare programs that serve millions of people. Listening, communication, and prioritization skills are more important to success than technical or business innovation.

About this Role

As a Senior Product Manager, you will work with minimal guidance to carry out product management work with cross-functional teams. You will define a compelling vision, generate a clear strategy to achieve it, then work with teams and partners to build out an agile roadmap for delivery. You are excited to build high functional teams and cooperative relationships.

It’s wonderful if you have a background in policy or healthcare, but you don’t need to have deep knowledge. What we do expect is that you enjoy building relationships across organizational boundaries and treat the contributions from other domains and functions as crucial for product success. Senior PMs do not have formal people management responsibilities, but skills in teaching and coaching are essential.

Skills and Responsibilities

Leadership

  • Creates connections across practices and disciplines
  • Provides clear and effective product management direction and vision for contract project team
  • Helps expand and deepen A1M's product practice
  • Provides mentoring and training to help internal A1M co-workers improve their product management skills
  • Demonstrates expertise navigating complex, multi-stakeholder environments
  • Takes the initiative to lead solutions
  • Coaches and guides teams using user-centered and agile-based methodologies

Strategic thinking

  • Convenes cross-functional teams to develop the right products/solutions
  • Co-creates product vision with product teams and client stakeholders
  • Able to differentiate between client requirements and requests in order to deliver on effective product or program strategy
  • Excellent oral and writing communication, interpersonal, storytelling, and analytical skills, including the ability to present concepts and complex technical material clearly and persuasively to colleagues, partners, stakeholders, and senior executives.

Delivery

  • Delivers value within target timelines while balancing competing priorities
  • Break down strategy and vision into doable chunks
  • Plan for compliance processes
  • Strong attention to detail, problem solving, and hands-on project organizational skills.

Relationship management

  • Demonstrates experience building cooperative relationships and coalitions with empathy, creativity situational awareness, and tact
  • Effectively navigates and resolves conflicting organizational priorities
  • Excellent people skills with a focus on building relationships
  • Skills in communicating back to company leadership on contract status, results, and needs for the contract’s success.

Minimum Qualifications

Education, Knowledge and Experience

Bachelor’s Degree in business administration, design, computer science, cognitive science, human-computer interaction (HCI), human factors, or a related field and 8+ years of full-time related professional experience.

Your resume or portfolio should demonstrate:

  • Prior experience working in government (local, state, or federal)
  • Familiarity with federal government delivery concerns such as ATO, FedRAMP, and PIAs
  • Critical thinking about the product development process
  • Delivering on projects from strategy through execution
  • Creating deliverables such as product roadmaps, OKRs, and user stories
  • Presenting and gathering buy-in on product judgment
  • Coordinating work in distributed, agile teams
  • Writing and presenting high-level editing and writing with limited supervision
  • Familiarity with modern web-based application development processes and tools

Nice, but not necessary:

  • Experience working with a social impact-focused product team or in civic tech
  • Experience working in government consulting engagements
  • Personal experience with government health and human services programs
  • Working knowledge of Medicare, the ACA, MACRA, Medicaid, or CHIP
  • Experience leading cross-functional teams in providing agile coaching services and wide-ranging curriculum on leadership, technology, and design
  • Familiarity with SAFe and flexibility in application of agile methodologies

Applicant Requirements

  • Our contracts require employees to work from the United States. That includes all 50 US states, the District of Columbia, and all US territories.
  • A1M employees must have been residents in the United States for 3 of the past 5 years.
  • Due to tax reasons, A1M employees cannot reside in New York state.
  • You must already have legal authorization to work within the US and not require ongoing visa sponsorship to maintain legal authorization to work.
  • You must be a permanent US resident.
  • Because A1M employees have access to government data and systems, new hires will need to complete a Public Trust form. Public Trust is a type of background investigation, but it is not a security clearance. Depending on the role, you must complete either the Standard Form 85 (SF85) or 85P (SF85P) questionnaire. You will at the very least get asked questions about where you’ve lived, worked, went to school, military history, police records, and substance use. You’ll also need to have your fingerprints taken.
  • Our partners primarily work on Eastern Standard Time (EST), and will require flexibility in your hours if you reside outside of EST. We do offer flexibility for non-work-related life responsibilities during the day.
  • Active participation in client virtual meetings, including being on camera, is an essential function that helps strengthen trust and open communication.

This a full-time, permanent position. The salary range for this role is $125,000 - $140,000.

Momentive Software is building its first dedicated Account Management team, and this role leads it. This is a zero-to-one role. You will define how Momentive manages accounts after the sale — from the team’s structure and duties to its process, tools, and targets — and then build the team that delivers it.

Position Summary

This role owns net revenue retention across Momentive’s client portfolio. You will design the Account Management function from the ground up: team structure, territories, quotas, and day-to-day duties. Then you will hire and coach the Account Managers who run it. You report to Josh Martin, SVP, Sales and work closely with Sales, Customer Success, Product, and Professional Services so clients renew, expand, and stay with Momentive.

A Day in the Life

  • Build the Account Management team from the ground up: define team structure, territories, and hiring plan, then recruit and onboard the first Account Managers.
  • Define the Account Manager role itself, including the core duties this team will own:
  • Manage a portfolio of existing Momentive clients, serving as their main point of contact after the sale.
  • Own renewals and retention for assigned accounts, working to catch churn risk before it happens.
  • Find and close expansion opportunities — cross-sell and upsell across the Momentive product portfolio.
  • Run regular account reviews with clients to track goals, surface risks, and show the value Momentive delivers.
  • Partner with Customer Success and Support so clients get one connected experience, not a handoff.
  • Keep Salesforce and related systems current with account plans, pipeline, and renewal dates.
  • Track and report against net revenue retention (NRR), renewal rate, and expansion targets.
  • Set quota, compensation recommendations, and success metrics for the Account Manager role, in partnership with Sales leadership and RevOps/Finance.
  • Coach and develop Account Managers through pipeline reviews, call shadowing, and account planning sessions.
  • Own the team’s forecast for retention, expansion, and renewal bookings, and report it monthly and quarterly to sales leadership.
  • Partner across Sales, Customer Success, Product, Marketing, and Professional Services to close gaps in the client experience.
  • Build the playbooks, templates, and enablement materials the Account Management team will use every day, including account plans, QBR decks, and renewal scripts.
  • Bring the client’s voice into product and roadmap conversations, flagging themes you see across the portfolio.
  • Stay current on the association and nonprofit technology landscape and the competitive dynamics that affect client retention.

We are looking for someone who brings

  • A track record of building a function, program, or team from scratch — not just running one that already exists.
  • Direct experience owning retention and expansion revenue against net revenue retention (NRR) targets.
  • Experience hiring, onboarding, and coaching account management or sales talent.

  • Strategic thinker who is just as comfortable working the details of a single account.
  • Strong financial and business acumen, able to connect account activity to revenue impact.
  • Willingness to travel up to 25% to meet with clients and support the team.

About Us

Momentive Software amplifies the impact of over 20,000 purpose-driven organizations in over 30 countries, with over $11 billion raised and 55 million members served to date. The Merchandise Planner, Boutique is a critical analytical role within DLC's global retail organization, responsible for driving financial performance across all 14 Rhoze luxury boutiques and Spa Boutique locations. Reporting to the Director of Retail Systems & FP&A, this role owns the planning, forecasting, and open-to-buy management function for the boutique channel — translating buying strategy into disciplined financial execution. This person will partner closely with boutique buyers, the Director of Retail Systems & FP&A, and regional operators to ensure inventory investment is optimized, sell-through targets are met, and the financial model supports DLC's premium brand positioning and rapid global expansion.

Duties & Responsibilities:

  • Financial Planning & OTB Management

    • Own and manage the open-to-buy (OTB) process across all Rhoze and Spa Boutique doors, ensuring disciplined inventory investment aligned to budget and sales plans.

    • Build and maintain seasonal and annual financial plans by door, region, and category including sales, receipts, margin, inventory turn, and IMU/GM% targets.

    • Reconcile OTB plans monthly in Management One; maintain accuracy of financial model inputs and outputs across all boutique locations.

    • Identify and flag OTB variances, supply/demand imbalances, and receipt flow issues proactively.

    • Support buyer-led purchasing decisions with financial guardrails, hindsight data, and scenario modeling.

  • Inventory Analysis & Sell-Through Optimization

    • Monitor sell-through, weeks-of-supply, and inventory productivity at the door, category, and brand level across all boutiques.

    • Develop and distribute regular reporting on inventory health — flagging underperformers, slow movers, and replenishment needs.

    • Collaborate with buyers and area managers to develop markdown and reorder strategies that protect margin while maintaining floor excitement.

    • Analyze seasonal performance versus plan; generate post-season recaps with actionable recommendations for future buys.

  • Buying Calendar & Seasonal Execution

    • Partner with boutique buyers to build and manage the seasonal buying calendar, ensuring OTB, receipt flow, and trade show timing are aligned.

    • Develop KPI tracking for boutique channel: revenue vs. plan, margin, turn, IMU, and sell-through by door and category.

    • Support Director of Retail Systems & FP&A with monthly financial report compilation, distribution, and data audits.

    • Provide ad hoc financial analysis and scenario modeling in support of new boutique openings, assortment decisions, and capital planning.

  • Cross-Functional Partnership

    • Serve as the planning and financial resource for boutique buyers — translating merchant strategy into executable, financially sound buying plans.

🚀 Our story

Partly is connecting the world's parts, and we're doing that by building the AI infrastructure layer for the global repair industry, starting with the $2tn automotive market. Our frontier model, Interpreter, is the world's first AI purpose-built to understand vehicle damage and the parts needed to fix it. Thousands of businesses across the global repair supply chain already rely on it.

Founded by ex-Rocket Lab engineers, we've tripled in size in the last 18 months and have recently raised a $50m Series B led by DST Global (Anthropic, Airbnb, Meta, TikTok, Spotify) and including Blackbird Ventures (Canva, CultureAmp etc.), WNDR, Activant Capital, Icehouse Ventures, Square Peg, Airtree, and Ecliptic Venture Capital. We're headquartered in Austin, with offices in New Zealand and London.

We're continuing to build a world-class team ensuring Partly is a place where people can do the best work of their lives. We're proud of the culture we've built, and our values are lived throughout every experience.

Want to learn more about the problems we're solving and the culture we're building at Partly? Hear directly from our team here:

TL;DR

Partly has solved one of the hardest problems in automotive parts data for some of the world's largest automotive businesses. Now we're bringing that technology to the U.S. repair industry—and we're looking for the person who will help build what's next.

Why Partly

The global replacement parts market is worth $1.9 trillion, yet much of the industry still runs on spreadsheets, phone calls, and outdated systems. We're building the infrastructure that modernizes how parts are sourced and procured—think Stripe, but for automotive parts.

We're backed by Blackbird Ventures (Canva, Culture Amp), Square Peg, and Octopus Ventures, with personal investment from Dylan Field (Figma) and Akshay Kothari (Notion). Our engineering roots come from Rocket Lab. We've tripled our team over the past year, have proven product-market fit, and power hundreds of businesses around the world.

We're past the "does this work?" stage. Now we're scaling into new markets—and the U.S. is our biggest opportunity yet.

🖍️ This role

The Sales Representative, Mid-Market, USA will lead Partly's expansion into the independent automotive and collision shop market starting in San Antonio, TX. They will report into the Head of Sales, USA.

This is an opportunity to disrupt a fragmented industry and pioneer how independent repairers source and procure parts.

This is an in-person, territory-owned field role. You will be in shops, not just on the phone: walking in, earning the conversation, and taking owners and operators from cold to active with Partly. You will be the engine behind our growth in this region, and you will do it on the ground, face to face.

You will be helping shape the playbook as you go - you'll test messaging, run high-volume outreach, and prove out a sales model built to scale.

This is a first-hire role. We're building the US mid-market motion from the ground up. You will have significant influence over how we approach this segment and the relationships you build will set the tone for future hires in the region.

💻 What will you do

  • Full-cycle sales: You own the process from walk-in to close. You will run in-person drop-ins, book and run discovery, demo the platform, and sign founding partners. You will build and manage your own pipeline with discipline and velocity.

  • Own your territory: You'll manage a specific region, building relationships with shop owners and operators, and leveraging local networks to open doors.

  • Translate tech to value: You'll explain how Partly solves real problems - saving time on invoicing, managing relationships with multiple suppliers, reducing manual data entry. You won't just demo software; you'll advise on procurement workflows.

  • Speak the shop's language: You will not just demo software. You will understand how shops estimate, how they source across OEM, aftermarket, and recycled parts, and how DRP scorecards shape behaviour. You will translate that into practical workflow value and implementation steps.

  • Consultative selling: You'll handle objections with confidence and work with customers to understand their current pain points and processes.

  • High-velocity hunting: You'll execute consistent outbound activity to generate your own pipeline. You aren't afraid of the phone and you understand that volume + quality = growth.

  • Collaborate: You'll collaborate with RevOps (deal tracking and analytics) and Onboarding to ensure smooth handoffs and fast time-to-value for new customers.

  • Pipeline discipline: You'll maintain rigorous CRM hygiene, forecast accurately, and keep a tight next-step cadence across active opportunities. You'll spot patterns (objections, blockers, feature requests) and feed them back to Product and GTM.

Want to learn more about the problems we're solving and the culture we're building at Partly? Hear directly from our team here:

🥷 Your skills

  • Commercial DNA: 2-4+ years of proven, high-velocity B2B sales — field, territory, or SaaS. You know how to hunt, consult, and close. Collision or independent automotive industry experience is a strong plus.

  • Field credibility: You can walk into a blue-collar shop, talk to the person with grease on their hands, and earn trust quickly. You read as genuine, not as a slick outsider.

  • Territory owner mentality: You thrive with autonomy. You can manage a region, build local relationships, and make sound decisions without needing constant guidance.

  • Comfortable in ambiguity: The systems are still being built. You see that as the opportunity, not the problem, and you help build them.

  • Resilient & proactive: You're prepared to get on the road or the phone. You handle rejection well and turn objections into conversations about ROI and workflow improvement.

  • Process driven: You can manage a high-velocity pipeline without dropping detail. You maintain discipline and suggest improvements when you see them.

  • Technically curious: You can learn how shops operate - inventory management, invoicing, supplier relationships - and translate that into practical implementation steps.

  • Ownership: You're proactive, resourceful, and comfortable being accountable for outcomes. You take pride in what you own.

Byte&Kite is a digital marketing agency helping clients across a range of industries grow through effective digital marketing. As a Business Development Manager, you will be responsible for winning new client accounts and managing the full sales cycle, from prospecting and referrals through discovery, pitching, proposal development, negotiation and close. You will work closely with delivery teams to ensure opportunities are well-qualified, commercially sound and aligned with what the agency can successfully deliver.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Generate new-business pipeline through outbound prospecting, referrals and professional networks

  • Identify and engage potential clients that are a strong fit for Byte&Kite's services

  • Run discovery calls and qualify opportunities based on client needs, budget, timeline and the agency's capabilities

  • Develop proposals and pitch presentations in collaboration with delivery and creative teams

  • Lead client pitches and clearly communicate the value of Byte&Kite's services

  • Build commercial proposals and defend pricing based on the value and scope of the work

  • Negotiate commercial terms and close new client agreements

  • Work with delivery teams to scope opportunities accurately before making commitments to clients

  • Maintain accurate pipeline information and provide regular updates on sales activity and forecasts

  • Ensure a smooth handover to account management with a clear and complete picture of client expectations, scope and commitments

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

  • 3+ years of new-business sales experience, ideally in a digital marketing agency, professional services or another consultative B2B environment

  • Proven track record of winning new business and closing recurring or retained client engagements

  • Experience managing the full sales cycle from prospecting through contract negotiation and close

  • Strong consultative selling skills and ability to understand a client's business challenges before positioning a solution

  • Confident presenting proposals and discussing commercial terms directly with decision-makers

  • Ability to defend pricing and negotiate effectively without relying on unnecessary discounting

  • Strong understanding of how to scope opportunities and collaborate with delivery teams before making client commitments

  • Excellent communication, presentation and negotiation skills

  • Comfortable working with sales targets, pipeline management and CRM systems

NICE TO HAVE

Digital marketing agency experience; existing B2B network; experience selling SEO, paid media, content or creative services; HubSpot or similar CRM experience; RFP experience; and experience selling to marketing leaders or other senior decision-makers.

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS

Competitive compensation based on experience and qualifications, with the full package discussed during the interview process. Professional development and training opportunities. Fully remote across US time zones, with additional company benefits discussed during the interview process.

HIRING PROCESS

Application review → Initial conversation → Interview → Offer

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY

Byte&Kite is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic. If you need an accommodation at any stage of the process, contact our recruiting team and we will arrange it.

The Data Scientist II leverages machine learning and Generative AI (LLMs) to deliver scalable, data-driven solutions that improve business performance and decision-making. This role builds and deploys predictive and LLM-based models using modern tools (CI/CD, Airflow), develops impactful insights through strong analytics and Power BI visualizations, and partners with stakeholders to identify high-value opportunities. The ideal candidate has strong analytical skills, a keen eye for data, and a passion for applying AI to real-world problems.

Key Objectives:

  • Deliver measurable business impact using machine learning and GenAI/LLM-driven solutions.
  • Improve operational performance through scalable, production-ready analytics.
  • Develop and maintain a suite of Power BI reports and dashboards to enable informed, data-driven business decisions.
  • Enable smarter decision-making through data storytelling and visualization.
  • Identify and implement high-value GenAI use cases across the organization.
  • Promote responsible and effective use of AI and advanced analytics.
  • Mentor junior team members and help elevate overall team capabilities.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities:

  • Analyze and integrate large, complex datasets from multiple sources, with cloud environments preferred.

jobs.excerpt: About A1There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks that are not AI-native.
jobs.description:
About A1

There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks that are not AI-native. Our mission is to build a proactive smart assistant for everyday users to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal prompting.

Our product focuses on achieving high reliability for long-running workflows, persistent context, and real-world task completion. The system must handle multi-step reasoning, interact with external tools, and remain reliable despite non-deterministic model behavior. Our objective is to help users complete tasks daily enjoyable with over ~90%* reduced time.

Role

You will be responsible for turning research direction into working, production-grade ML systems. This role owns the execution layer of A1’s intelligence – training pipelines, inference systems, evaluation tooling, and deployment.

Focus

  • Build and own end-to-end ML pipelines spanning data, training, evaluation, inference, and deployment.

  • Fine-tune and adapt models using state-of-the-art methods such as LoRA, QLoRA, SFT, DPO, and distillation.

  • Architect and operate scalable inference systems, balancing latency, cost, and reliability.

  • Design and maintain data systems for high-quality synthetic and real-world training data.

  • Implement evaluation pipelines covering performance, robustness, safety, and bias, in partnership with research leadership.

  • Own production deployment, including GPU optimization, memory efficiency, latency reduction, and scaling policies.

  • Collaborate closely with application engineering to integrate ML systems cleanly into backend, mobile, and desktop products.

  • Make pragmatic trade-offs and ship improvements quickly, learning from real usage.

  • Work under real production constraints: latency, cost, reliability, and safety

Requirements

  • Strong background in deep learning and transformer-based architectures.

  • Hands-on experience training, fine-tuning, or deploying large-scale ML models in production.

  • Proficiency with at least one modern ML framework (e.g. PyTorch, JAX), and ability to learn others quickly.

  • Experience with distributed training and inference frameworks (e.g. DeepSpeed, FSDP, Megatron, ZeRO, Ray).

  • Strong software engineering fundamentals – you write robust, maintainable, production-grade systems.

  • Experience with GPU optimization, including memory efficiency, quantization, and mixed precision.

  • Comfort owning ambiguous, zero-to-one ML systems end-to-end.

  • A bias toward shipping, learning fast, and improving systems through iteration.

Ideal Experience

  • Experience with LLM inference frameworks such as vLLM, TensorRT-LLM, or FasterTransformer.

  • Contributions to open-source ML or systems libraries.

  • Background in scientific computing, compilers, or GPU kernels.

  • Experience with RLHF pipelines (PPO, DPO, ORPO).

  • Experience training or deploying multimodal or diffusion models.

  • Experience with large-scale data processing (Apache Arrow, Spark, Ray).

How We Work

The best products today in the world were built by small, world class teams. We are a high talent density and hands-on team. We make decisions collectively, move at rapid speed, striking a balance between shipping high quality work and learning. Joining our team requires the ability to bring structure, exercise judgment, and execute independently. Our goal is to put in hands of our users a truly magical product

Interview process

If there appears to be a fit, we'll reach to schedule 3, but no more than 4 interviews.

Applications are evaluated by our technical team members. Interviews will be conducted via virtual meetings and/or onsite.

We value transparency and efficiency, so expect a prompt decision. If you've demonstrated the exceptional skills and mindset we're looking for, we'll extend an offer to join us. This isn't just a job offer; it's an invitation to be part of a team that's bringing AI to have practical benefits to billions globally.

About the Role and Your Impact:

We’re looking for a Senior DevOps Engineer as we are expanding our small (3 people) but mighty team responsible for the platform. We need an engineer who treats infrastructure like software engineering. You should have a deep grasp of Azure internals, a "Platform-as-a-Product" mindset, and the confidence to lead a feature end-to-end, communicating with your "customers" (our developers) translating their needs into solid, scalable platform components.

Your mission: abstract away complexity so developers can ship fast without worrying about networking, permissions, or infrastructure details.

What You Will Do:

  • Design and build “golden paths” and platform components that make development fast, safe, and frictionless

  • Architect Azure Landing Zones using Terraform

  • Build and evolve our platform using Azure Container Apps, App Services, and Functions

  • Create reusable modules and CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions) with built-in security and quality checks

  • Own the “hard parts” — networking, security, and connectivity — and make them invisible to developers

  • Automate processes using Python, Bash, or PowerShell

  • Drive initiatives end-to-end: gather feedback, demo solutions, iterate fast

  • Take part in a support routine. We follow a clear ownership model: product teams own their applications, while we focus on the platform incidents and assistance.

  • Shape our future platform strategy

What We Offer:

  • B2B contract with a U.S.-based company

  • Remote-first work environment

  • Flexible working hours

  • Hourly rate: $40-50 (Compensation paid in USD, with a fixed exchange rate of 1 USD = 4 PLN)

  • $1,000 annual learning budget + paid learning time (up to 3h/week)

  • MyBenefit cafeteria program

  • Fully funded offsites

  • All necessary equipment and software & AI licenses provided

  • Real ownership and impact

  • Modern stack, no legacy baggage

  • Space to experiment and innovate

  • A culture that’s still startup-like: fast, pragmatic, and low on bureaucracy

Requirements

What You Bring:

  • Full initiative ownership, which includes running demos for our developers and DevOps Agents to gather feedback and iterate until the solution is truly solid.

  • A Platform-as-a-Product mindset (you build for developers, not tickets)

  • Strong Azure expertise (Architecture, Landing Zones, RBAC, networking, ACR, ARM/Bicep, and cost optimization)

  • Solid experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform + module design, state management)

  • CI/CD experience (GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps Pipelines)

  • Fluent in English and Polish (at least C1).

  • Strong understanding of cloud security and identity (Azure AD, policies, scanning tools, etc.)

  • Experience with platform engineering/developer enablement

  • Observability tooling expertise (Azure Monitor, App Insights, Log Analytics, or similar)

  • Scripting skills (Python, Bash, or PowerShell)

  • Experience working closely with engineering teams in agile environments

  • Containerization best practices knowledge

Additional Assets:

  • Experience with coding AI agents (Claude, Codex, Copilot)

  • Experience with security practices across the SDLC (supply chain protection, SAST, DAST, WAF)

  • Experience configuring and working with the LGTM stack

  • Previous work experience at a product company

About CouponFollow

CouponFollow helps millions of shoppers save money online through our website and Cently browser extension. We're a remote-first product company of around 80 people, with engineering teams primarily based in Poland and business teams in the U.S. Our teams are organized around products, bringing together Engineering, Product, and business stakeholders to solve real problems, experiment quickly, and deliver measurable business impact.

Why Join CouponFollow?

You'll build the platform that enables every engineering team at CouponFollow to move faster, ship with confidence, and focus on solving customer problems instead of infrastructure complexity.

We believe great platform engineers combine deep technical expertise with product thinking. Your customers are our developers, and your success is measured by how much easier, safer, and faster you make software delivery across the company.

jobs.title: UX & Product Design Lead
jobs.excerpt: About bunny. netSome people accept the internet as it is.
jobs.description:
About bunny.net

Some people accept the internet as it is. We see what it could be.

At bunny.net, we don’t wait for change. We make it happen. You won’t find layers of red tape or play-it-safe thinking here. You’ll find people who move quickly, take ownership, and push ideas all the way to the edge. Literally.

You’ll build things that solve actual problems, not add to them.

We’re not perfect, and we don’t pretend to be. But we’re always improving. We’re looking for people who want to do the same, who take pride in their work, and aren’t afraid to challenge what’s possible.

Because everyone deserves a better internet. And we’re here to help it hop faster.

UX & Product Design Lead

The internet runs on infrastructure. But using that infrastructure shouldn't feel... well, like infrastructure.

That's where you come in.

As our UX & Product Design Lead, you'll help shape how developers experience bunny.net.

Working closely with product managers and engineers, you'll own the UX journey from early product ideas through to polished experiences developers love using.

This isn't a role where you'll approve every mockup. You'll be hands-on where it matters most, solving meaningful product challenges while building the systems, patterns, and culture that help great UX scale across bunny.net.

You'll spend your time experimenting with new ideas, using AI to move faster, and continuously refining the experiences we build.

The best UX often goes unnoticed, because everything just works.

If that excites you, you'll feel right at home.

What will you do?

  • Make powerful technology feel beautifully simple

  • Shape the experience of products used by developers around the world

  • Work side by side with product managers and engineers to solve tough problems

  • Build the systems and design patterns that help great UX scale

  • Prototype, experiment, and explore with AI and modern design tools

  • Lead and set standards for user research and define the personas that guide every design decision

  • Talk to customers often, and let their feedback shape what we build

  • Bring clarity to complex product decisions through design workshops and reviews

  • Raise the bar for usability, accessibility, and thoughtful product design

  • Help others become better designers by sharing knowledge, giving feedback, and leading by example

What will you bring?

  • 7+ years of experience in UX, product design, or a similar role

  • Experience designing cloud infrastructure, and/or products for developers

  • Confidence designing for technical users, especially developers

  • Ability to conduct qualitative and quantitative user research

  • A talent for turning technical complexity into intuitive experiences

  • Systems thinking: you know when to solve a problem once, and when to create a pattern that solves it for everyone

  • The ability to zoom out to strategy and dive into the details when it matters

  • A collaborative mindset and the ability to work closely with engineers to balance user needs with technical realities

  • Clear communication and the confidence to explain your thinking to anyone, from engineers to leadership

  • Curiosity about AI and modern tools, and a desire to keep improving how products are designed and built

  • An obsession with the little details that make powerful products feel fast, simple, and effortless

What will make us extra happy?

  • Experience building design systems, component libraries, or design tokens

  • Familiarity with frontend technologies like HTML, CSS, JavaScript, or Angular

  • Experience designing for APIs, cloud platforms, infrastructure, security, or other developer tools

  • Experience using AI to accelerate research, prototyping, or product design

  • Experience mentoring designers or helping scale design practices in a product organization

Where should you be located?

Europe, ideally within CET ±3 hours so collaboration with the team feels natural rather than scheduled.

What's in it for you?

Life at bunny.net comes with benefits that make work (and life) better.

  • 100% flexible hours - Your work, your rhythm. Whether you thrive at 3 am or on a beach at noon, we've got you.

  • Remote-first by design - No offices, no commute, just the freedom to work anywhere. Miss the office? We’ll give you a 3-night voucher for visiting our headquarters.

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance - Coverage worldwide.

  • Paid time off - Love the slopes or the sea? Enjoy them with 25 vacation days, plus an extra loyalty day each year, capped at 5 years (30 days total), on top of your local public holidays.

  • Meeting-free Thursdays - We keep Thursdays meeting free internally so you can focus on deep work without interruptions.

  • Home office budget - We believe everyone is more efficient working in a comfortable office, and we're happy to help you set it up with an annual budget of €500.

  • Paid sick leave - Feeling ill? Take time off to fully recover without having to worry about your finances.

  • Parental leave - Paid 16 weeks for birthing parents, 8 weeks for non-birthing parents. If your country gives more, that’s your baseline. If it gives less, we top it up. Take your leave all at once or split it across the first year for maximum flexibility. After paid leave, your local statutory rules apply.

  • Annual fluffle building - We're remote, but not distant! Once a year, we meet in a sunny location where virtual high-fives turn into real ones.

  • Employee Stock Option Plan (ESOP) - Everyone at bunny.net gets a piece of the pie, starting with 0.01% equity.

  • Mental health support - Feeling down? We've got your back. bunny.net provides mental health resources and help via .

  • Wellness budget - An annual well-being budget of €480 is here to help you stay fresh and focused.

  • Educational budget - €500 yearly for books, seminars, or online courses to keep your learning on track, work-related or not.

  • Music on us: Work is better with music. Enjoy a yearly Apple, Spotify, or YouTube Premium subscription on us.

deine aufgaben

  • Gemeinsam stark: Du entwickelst die Kundenplattform operativ weiter und wirkst aktiv an der übergeordneten strategischen Ausrichtung sowie der Business-Transformation mit. Deine Erkenntnisse aus dem Betrieb fließen direkt in die langfristige Planung ein.

  • Transparenz: Du koordinierst das Incident-Management souverän und sorgst jederzeit für einen klaren Informationsfluss.
Technische Analyse, QA & Hands-on

  • Hands-on: Du bleibst technisch am Ball: Deklarative Anforderungen (Admin-Tasks, einfache Flows) setzt du eigenständig um, um flexibel zu bleiben und dein Plattformwissen nicht nur aktuell zu halten, sondern kontinuierlich auszubauen

dein profil

Du verstehst Service nicht als bloßes Reagieren, sondern als proaktives Gestalten? Wir suchen kommunikationsstarke Persönlichkeiten, die technische Leidenschaft mit wirtschaftlichem Verständnis verbinden und Freude daran haben, Salesforce-Plattformen nachhaltig weiterzuentwickeln und den Kundenerfolg langfristig zu sichern.

GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

Staff Forward Deployed Engineer, Agentic SDLC - (EMEA Only)An overview of this role

GitLab’s Forward Deployed Engineering team is a field-situated product engineering function focused on strategic customer outcomes, artificial intelligence (AI) adoption, and direct contributions to GitLab’s product. This isn't a traditional field engineering, solutions architecture, or professional services role. As a Staff Forward Deployed Engineer, you'll work closely with customers while maintaining the technical standards and contribution discipline of a Staff-level product engineer.

You'll work where strategic customer urgency, complex technical ambiguity, and GitLab product execution intersect. You'll partner directly with strategic customers and teams across Product, Engineering, Support, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), Solutions Architecture (SA), Customer Success Architecture (CSA), Customer Success Management (CSM), and Professional Services. You'll diagnose and resolve high-impact adoption blockers, contribute production-quality fixes and features, and turn what you learn into repeatable patterns for GitLab and its customers.

Why this role exists

Strategic customers sometimes encounter challenges that are too broad, deep, urgent, or cross-functional for any single team to own from start to finish. These challenges may involve product gaps, performance degradation, scale bottlenecks, AI governance, adoption blockers, architectural constraints, Git usage patterns, continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) complexity, application programming interface (API) automation, security requirements, or operational instability.

Forward Deployed Engineering provides technical stewardship in these moments. The team doesn't simply observe, report, or escalate. You'll engage directly, diagnose the underlying technical problem, collaborate with the right teams, contribute code or technical solutions where appropriate, and transition the outcome into normal ownership once the customer is stable and the learning can be reused.

What you’ll do

Product contribution

  • Contribute production-quality code to GitLab’s product and adjacent systems.
  • Develop bug fixes, features, integrations, tooling, and performance improvements when strategic customer outcomes require direct engineering work.
  • Work within GitLab’s product and engineering processes, including issue discovery, merge request creation, testing, review, documentation, and maintainability.
  • Partner with Product and Engineering so customer-driven solutions support long-term product direction rather than becoming one-off customizations.
  • Turn blockers discovered in the field into durable product improvements, reference architectures, documentation, and repeatable implementation patterns.

Strategic technical stewardship

  • Engage with strategically important customers when adoption, retention, executive confidence, or public trust is materially at risk.
  • Diagnose complex problems across GitLab product behavior, customer architecture, Git internals, CI/CD workflows, API usage, observability, infrastructure, networking, and cloud environments.
  • Coordinate across Product, Engineering, SRE, Support, SA, CSA, CSM, Professional Services, and customer technical teams to drive resolution from discovery through handoff.
  • Provide recommendations grounded in data, traces, and systems analysis to improve GitLab usage, workflows, automation, and architecture.
  • Create durable outcomes without establishing permanent dependency on Forward Deployed Engineering.

AI adoption and agentic software development lifecycle

  • Drive governed, measurable, and production-oriented adoption of GitLab Duo Agent Platform with strategic customers.
  • Identify and resolve AI adoption blockers involving governance, usage controls, auditability, security, compliance, operating models, workflow design, and integrations.
  • Develop customer-safe adoption patterns for the agentic software development lifecycle (SDLC), AI-assisted development, intent-based review, AI governance, and human-in-the-loop software delivery.
  • Partner with Product, Engineering, Field, and Customer Success teams to turn AI adoption learning into reusable guidance and product improvements.

Thought leadership

  • Create technical narratives grounded in customer experience and product reality that can help shape the industry’s approach.
  • Contribute to Well-Architected Frameworks, whitepapers, webinars, reference architectures, technical strategy memos, and adoption frameworks.
  • Guide ideas through discovery, formulation, validation, amplification, and adoption across GitLab.
  • Partner with SA, CSA, Product, Engineering, Marketing, Product Marketing Management, CSM, Support, and executive stakeholders to make technical thought leadership a shared company capability.

What you’ll bring

  • Staff-level experience building, operating, or improving complex production software systems.
  • Experience contributing to large, mature product codebases with high standards for testing, maintainability, performance, and security.
  • Strong Ruby on Rails or Go experience and the ability to contribute directly to GitLab’s product and adjacent systems.
  • Experience with AI-assisted software development, agentic workflows, AI governance, model evaluation, context management, prompt and workflow design, or AI adoption in enterprise environments.
  • Experience diagnosing complex system behavior across application code, data stores, infrastructure, observability, networking, APIs, and customer usage patterns.
  • Deep knowledge of modern DevSecOps workflows, including Git, merge requests, CI/CD, security controls, compliance needs, and enterprise software delivery.
  • Experience working with strategic customers or senior technical stakeholders in ambiguous, high-impact situations.
  • The ability to coordinate across product, engineering, field, and customer teams without formal authority.
  • Strong written communication and sound judgment, including the ability to create technical narratives and distinguish reusable product work from customer-specific customization.

Strongly preferred qualifications

  • Direct experience with GitLab as a platform, including GitLab.com, GitLab Dedicated, or GitLab Self-Managed.
  • Production experience with Ruby on Rails, Go, PostgreSQL, Redis, Sidekiq, Vue, TypeScript, Kubernetes, Docker, Linux, or observability tools.
  • Deep familiarity with Git internals, repository performance, large-scale Git usage patterns, or GitLab Runner behavior.
  • Experience creating technical thought-leadership materials, such as whitepapers, technical talks, architecture frameworks, requests for comments, public technical writing, or internal strategy documents.
  • A background in performance engineering, site reliability engineering, platform engineering, infrastructure engineering, or distributed systems.
  • Experience working in open source or highly asynchronous engineering environments.

Technologies and domains

Directly relevant technologies and domains include:

  • Ruby on Rails
  • Go
  • AI-assisted development and the agentic SDLC
  • PostgreSQL
  • Redis and Sidekiq
  • Git internals
  • GitLab CI/CD and Runner architecture
  • Kubernetes and containers
  • Terraform
  • Linux, networking, observability, and performance analysis
  • Vue and TypeScript
  • APIs and automation
  • DevSecOps governance, security, and compliance

What this role is not

This role isn't:

  • A generic field engineering role.
  • A proof-of-concept factory.
  • A replacement for Solutions Architecture, Customer Success Architecture, Customer Success Management, Professional Services, Support, SRE, Product, or Engineering.
  • A customer-specific customization function.
  • Unbilled Professional Services.
  • A requirements-gathering role that only escalates to Product.
  • An AI evangelism role disconnected from product execution.

Success measures

Success in this role may include:

  • Stabilizing strategic customer adoption or retention risks.
  • Fixing product bugs or contributing features.
  • Removing AI adoption blockers for strategic accounts.
  • Creating reusable implementation patterns and transitioning them to long-term owners.
  • Producing or enabling Well-Architected Frameworks, whitepapers, webinars, or technical narratives.
  • Resolving cross-functional customer challenges without creating permanent dependency on Forward Deployed Engineering.
  • Equipping Product, Engineering, Support, CSA, CSM, Professional Services, and SA teams with better guidance based on learning from the field.
  • Increasing adoption and effective use of GitLab capabilities, especially GitLab Duo and GitLab Duo Agent Platform, in targeted accounts.

About the team

The Forward Deployed Engineering team connects strategic customer needs with GitLab product execution. The team works directly with customers and across GitLab to resolve complex adoption challenges, contribute durable product improvements, and create reusable technical guidance. Its goal is to stabilize urgent situations, improve the product, and transition ongoing ownership to the appropriate team rather than create a permanent dependency.

Ideal candidate profile

You're a Staff-level product or platform engineer who can operate in the field without becoming field-only. You're comfortable reading traces, writing production code, debugging architecture, discussing AI governance, leading a customer technical session, opening a merge request, outlining a whitepaper, and coordinating across teams to achieve a strategic customer outcome.

You're not simply a strong communicator with technical awareness. You're a credible engineer with the judgment, presence, and narrative ability to turn customer reality into product contributions, adoption guidance, and company-level thought leadership.

We welcome candidates with different backgrounds and levels of experience. Many successful candidates don't meet every qualification. If you're excited about this role, we encourage you to apply and let our recruiting team assess your application.

  • Flexible Paid Time Off

Associate Sales Recruiter

Remote, Canada | Full-Time


This posting reflects an actively open, existing vacancy at Peak Sales Recruiting.

About Peak Sales Recruiting

At Peak Sales Recruiting, our purpose is clear: we drive organizations and individuals to achieve excellence.

For more than two decades, we have partnered with growth-oriented organizations across North America to identify and secure exceptional B2B sales talent. As a leading executive search firm focused exclusively on sales, we help companies build elite teams that drive revenue, accelerate growth, and create lasting competitive advantage.

Our success is built on four core values:

  • Driven to Achieve Excellence
  • Disciplined to Do the Right Thing the Right Way
  • Of Service to Empower Excellence in Others
  • Always Improving to Reach New Heights

We believe exceptional results come from discipline, accountability, continuous improvement, and a genuine commitment to serving others. Our team thrives in a high-performance, fully remote environment where collaboration and ownership drive meaningful outcomes for clients and candidates alike.

Position Summary

We are looking for an Associate Sales Recruiter to join our growing team.

As an Associate Sales Recruiter, you will help organizations achieve sales excellence by identifying, engaging, and delivering exceptional B2B sales talent.

You will partner closely with our sales team, which owns the client relationship, so you can focus on finding exceptional candidates, building trust with them, and delivering outstanding search outcomes.

This is an early-career opportunity for someone who is highly competitive, driven, coachable, and excited to build a career in recruiting. You want pressure. You want a scoreboard. You want to be measured against clear targets and know exactly where you stand. You do not need years of recruiting experience, but you do need the resilience to hear “no,” the discipline to keep going, and the desire to compete, improve, and win as part of a high-performing team. We will teach you Peak’s search methodology and give you the coaching, tools, and opportunity to take ownership of your searches.

What You'll Be Doing

Search Execution

  • Learn and own the full recruitment process, from search launch through placement.
  • Partner with Sales to execute search engagements.
  • Source and identify top-performing B2B sales professionals across North America using LinkedIn Recruiter, databases, referrals, market research, and other creative sourcing methods.
  • Make a high volume of outbound calls and messages every day to engage passive candidates, generate interest, and build strong talent pipelines.
  • Conduct structured phone and video screens to assess each candidate’s experience, performance, motivation, communication skills, and fit for the opportunity.
  • Deliver highly qualified candidate shortlists aligned with client expectations and Peak standards.
  • Execute each engagement utilizing Peak's proven search methodology.

Candidate Relationship Management

  • Develop long-term relationships with sales professionals built on trust and credibility.
  • Deliver a best-in-class candidate experience through consistent communication and professionalism.
  • Build the knowledge and credibility to guide candidates throughout the search process.
  • Represent the Peak brand with integrity and excellence in every interaction.

Performance Excellence

  • Achieve and exceed activity, pipeline, and placement objectives.
  • Maintain accurate and disciplined data management within Salesforce.
  • Effectively manage multiple search engagements without compromising quality.
  • Collaborate with teammates to continuously improve processes and outcomes.
  • Demonstrate Peak's purpose and values in all aspects of your work.

Collaboration and Continuous Improvement

  • Partner cross-functionally with Sales and internal teammates to deliver exceptional results.
  • Share best practices and contribute to the ongoing development of processes and standards.
  • Support a culture of accountability, teamwork, and continuous improvement.

What You Bring

  • Up to one year of experience in recruiting, sales, business development, customer service, or another fast-paced, results-driven environment. Direct recruiting experience is not required.
  • A track record of competing, pushing through setbacks, and working relentlessly toward ambitious goals.
  • A background in competitive athletics, performance-based sales, entrepreneurship, or another environment where results are earned is a strong asset.
  • Strong communication skills and the confidence to speak with accomplished sales professionals.
  • Comfortable with high levels of outbound activity and relationship building by phone, video, and digital channels.
  • Thrives under pressure and is energized by competition, clear targets, scoreboards, and being measured on results.
  • Resilient, coachable, organized, disciplined, and personally accountable.
  • Experience with Salesforce, LinkedIn Recruiter, or applicant tracking systems is helpful but not required.
  • A commitment to excellence, continuous improvement, and helping others achieve their highest potential.

What We Offer

Remote-First, Flexible Culture

100% remote work environment with company-provided equipment. Our model gives you autonomy and flexibility, built on trust and clear expectations rather than watching a clock.

Wellness and Growth:

  • Three weeks of vacation, plus five PTO days annually
  • Comprehensive benefits after 90 days
  • RRSP matching after six months
  • $750 annual Health & Wellness Allowance, in addition to our benefits program
  • Uncapped commissions and performance incentives
  • Ongoing professional development and career advancement opportunities

Why Peak Sales Recruiting?

At Peak Sales Recruiting, you will join a team that believes excellence is a journey, not a destination. You will learn from high-performing professionals, build meaningful candidate relationships, and contribute to the success of organizations across North America.

If you are hungry to build a career in recruiting, thrive in a competitive environment, and want your effort to have a direct impact on your results, we want to hear from you.

Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity & Belonging

Peak is committed to building a team that reflects the range of experience and perspective our clients and candidates bring to us every day. We evaluate every application on merit, fit against our values, and demonstrated ability to do the work, and we welcome applicants of all backgrounds.

If you require an accommodation at any stage of our interview process, let us know and we will work with you to provide one.

AI in Recruitment at Peak

Peak Sales Recruiting does not use artificial intelligence to screen applications. Every application is reviewed by a member of our team.

Official Recruitment Notice

All applications to Peak Sales Recruiting are reviewed directly by our internal team. Legitimate communication from us will only come from an email address ending in [@peaksalesrecruiting.com, confirm exact domain].

Peak will never ask you for payment, banking details, or personal financial information at any stage of our recruitment process. If you receive a suspicious message claiming to represent Peak, please reach out to us directly to verify it before responding.

Compensation & Pay Transparency

At Peak, we believe in pay transparency, equity, and fairness. We benchmark compensation against comparable executive search and B2B sales talent organizations, and we review our ranges regularly to keep them competitive and aligned with market data.

Expected first-year total annual compensation for this role ranges from $60,000 to $100,000+, consisting of a competitive base salary, uncapped commissions, and performance-based incentives. Actual earnings will vary based on experience, results, and overall contribution, with top performers having the opportunity to exceed this range.

The Grant Management Consultant will work collaboratively across Program & Policy (P&P), the World Vision Partnership, and with Field Offices, Regional Offices, and the Global Centre to support delivery against P&P’s three strategic priorities: Impact, Income, and Influence.

The Consultant will provide end-to-end grant management expertise to optimize resources, strengthen delivery quality, and ensure institutional donor-funded projects are implemented in line with approved project design documents, donor agreements, and World Vision standards. We are proactively identifying independent consultants who may be engaged on a contract basis should grant funding be approved.

jobs.excerpt: Flex is building the AI-native private bank for business owners.
jobs.description:
Flex is building the AI-native private bank for business owners.

We’re re-architecting the entire financial system for entrepreneurs—from the first dollar a business earns to how that value compounds, moves, and is ultimately spent in real life. Banking, credit, payments, personal finance, and financial operations—rebuilt from the ground up as a single, intelligent system. Flex is the full financial home for ambitious owners.

Since launching publicly in September 2023, Flex has scaled from zero to nine-figure annualized revenue, with a clear path to profitability by late 2026. We move fast, ship relentlessly, and operate with extreme ownership.

Our customers are affluent business owners ($3–$200M in revenue)—the backbone of the economy and one of the most underserved segments in finance. They’re stuck with outdated banks and fragmented tools. We’re replacing all of it. The opportunity is massive: a ~$1T+ revenue market hiding in plain sight. Our ambition is to build a product that is fundamentally better—not incrementally improved.

Flex Fuels Ambition.

The Collections Risk Management Lead is a key member of the Flex Risk Management Leadership Team (reports to the Chief Risk Officer) who will have the opportunity to take the Fraud Risk Management function at Flex to a level that rivals the best in class.

Core Responsibilities

  • Own end-to-end collections risk management for Flex's credit card portfolio across consumer and small business segments — end-to-end meaning full lifecycle coverage from early delinquency through post charge-off recovery:
    • Early stage collections: monitor roll rates and delinquency migration across DPD buckets; design and refine treatment strategies by risk segment, balance tier, and obligor type; optimize contact timing, channel mix, and messaging to maximize cure rates before accounts deteriorate further
    • Late stage collections: manage pre-charge-off intervention strategies; own the analytical framework for determining when accounts warrant accelerated action versus continued treatment; maintain visibility into cure and re-default patterns by treatment cohort
    • Hardship & modification management: maintain analytical visibility into hardship program utilization, modification outcomes, and re-default rates; identify where hardship programs are being used appropriately versus as avoidance behavior
    • Settlement strategy: define settlement authorization frameworks by balance tier, DPD, and obligor type; evaluate the NPV trade-off between discounted resolution and continued collection effort; govern agency settlement authority to avoid both under-recovery and adverse selection among accounts that would have paid in full
    • Vendor & agency management: define the strategic boundary between in-house collections and third-party placement — knowing when to keep accounts internal and when placement generates better expected recovery net of cost; evaluate and manage agency relationships on the basis of liquidation rates, compliance posture, consumer treatment standards, and cost-to-collect; own the KPI framework for vendor performance and hold agencies accountable to it
    • Litigation: identify accounts where legal escalation is warranted based on balance size, recovery probability, and obligor profile; maintain an analytical framework for litigation referral thresholds and track outcomes by segment; understand the owner-as-guarantor dimension in SMB accounts and where personal liability creates additional recovery optionality
    • Charge-off & recovery: own charge-off timing policy and its interaction with loss reserve mechanics; build and maintain recovery rate forecasts by vintage, segment, and channel; track net loss emergence and recovery curves over time
    • SMB-specific collections dynamics: apply a distinct analytical lens to small business obligors — seasonal cash flow patterns, owner-business financial entanglement, and the limits of standard consumer treatment strategies in a business context
  • Build and maintain collections performance frameworks that surface deterioration signals early and enable proactive treatment rather than reactive loss management
  • Synthesize data across sources — payment history, bureau refreshes, transaction behavior, contact records, and macro indicators — to segment the delinquent population intelligently and match treatment intensity to recovery probability
  • Lead periodic collections reviews: own the data, design the narrative, and present delinquency trends, recovery performance, and vendor outcomes to risk committees and senior leadership
  • Partner cross-functionally with credit, legal & compliance, finance, and operations to ensure collections strategy is aligned with loss reserve inputs, regulatory obligations, and customer experience standards
  • Contribute to stress testing and loss forecasting: model collections performance under adverse conditions and translate recovery assumptions into net loss projections
  • Serve as the internal SME on collections analytics — establishing measurement standards, treatment logic, and vendor governance frameworks as the portfolio scales

Qualifications

    This role sits in the foundational build path of core risk management disciplines, and we expect significant upward potential for the right candidate. The emphasis is on finding colleagues with a strong foundation more than a ‘minimum number of years’ constraint. We can work with people who have 7–15 years of hands-on Collections risk management experience; direct exposure to both a bank or regulated card program and a fintech strongly preferred
    Hands-on familiarity with the full delinquency lifecycle: DPD bucket management, treatment strategy design, charge-off policy, recovery curve modeling, and net loss attribution
    Practical experience managing or working alongside third-party collections agencies — understands liquidation economics, placement timing trade-offs, cost-to-collect dynamics, and how to build a KPI framework that holds vendors accountable without creating perverse incentives
    Analytically self-sufficient: proficient in SQL and Python or R; capable of building roll rate matrices, cure rate cohorts, and recovery forecasts from raw data rather than consuming pre-built reports
    Familiar with the regulatory overlay on collections: FDCPA obligations, Reg F communication rules, UDAAP considerations in treatment strategy design, and state-level restrictions that affect contact and remediation practices
    Understands the distinct dynamics of SMB collections — cash flow seasonality, the owner as guarantor, and where standard consumer treatment logic breaks down

Mindset

    Operates at a senior thinking level relative to peer cohort — brings a point of view on collections strategy, challenges treatment assumptions, and drives the recovery agenda without waiting to be directed
    Thinks about collections as a risk management discipline, not a call center operation — brings analytical rigor to treatment design, vendor selection, and loss forecasting, not just operational execution
    Balances recovery maximization with consumer and business treatment standards — understands that how you collect matters as much as how much you collect, particularly in a regulated and reputationally sensitive environment
    High quantitative aptitude: strong intuitive feel for what roll rates, cure rates, and recovery curves should look like by segment and vintage, and catches anomalies before they surface in reviews
    Effective communicator who can translate delinquency and recovery dynamics into crisp narratives for risk committees, finance, and senior leadership — equally comfortable in the data and in the room

Director, CIO Analyst: Thought Leader on Technology Operations — Remote US/Canada

Description

Gartner is seeking a Director Analyst for our CIO and AI Leader group to serve as a strategic thought leader for the future of technology implementation and operations. In this role, you won’t just track trends—you will define the playbook for how CIOs, from the world's largest companies, newest startups, and innovative governments, secure and modernize their enterprises through the lens of AI and data-driven transformation. Leveraging over 10+ years of technology executive experience and passion for learning, you will transform complex shifts in technologies, practices, and markets into actionable insights, mentoring global leaders and commanding the stage as a definitive voice in the industry.

About the role:

As a Director Analyst in Gartner’s Business CIO & AI Leaders group, you will serve as a global thought leader within Business & Technology Insights. In this role, you will help CIOs and tech executives from around the world securely architect technology, data, and AI for modernization and innovation. Leveraging deep analytical and strong communications skills, you will produce essential research and directly counsel clients through written content, executive briefings, and Gartner conferences to solve mission-critical enterprise challenges.

What you will do:

  • Be an industry thought leader

    • Build credibility as an expert representing Gartner Business and Technology Insights on topics such as application modernization, integration of AI into operations, and platform implementation

    • Drive the global conversation platforms and application modernization through Gartner and the media

  • Conduct insightful research

    • Track global market trends related to core industries, relevant vendors, emerging technologies, and best practices

    • Actively participate in ideation, cohort discussions to establish strong positions on technical topics that impact CIOs

    • Lead qualitative and quantitative studies to establish thought-provoking insights for our C-level clients

    • Identify research process improvements or develop new processes that help the team and the Business and Technology Insights group excel in delivering client value

  • Create thought provoking content for clients

    • Deliver high-quality, actionable advice to an executive client audience, CIOs, AI Leaders, and Technology Executives, through a variety of media.

    • Write evidence-based content that is easily consumed, defensible and actionable.

    • Develop compelling presentations that help clients understand the constantly evolving technology and operation landscape

  • Engage clients in how to achieve their mission critical priorities

    • Advise CIOs and IT Executives in staying ahead in a constantly evolving technology landscape and changing geopolitical uncertainties

    • Deliver thought-provoking presentations for webinars, executive briefings, and industry conferences, and Gartner events.

What you will need:

  • 10+ years’ experience working as an information technology executive, AI experience in P&C insurance or government is a plus

  • Bachelor's degree in a related field or an equivalent combination of education and experience required

  • Intellectual curiosity to continuously learn and explore new ideas

  • A deep technical background founded in IT department engineering experience (e.g. platform engineer for AI, systems engineer, information security engineer, cloud engineer, solutions architect etc.)

  • Experience helping organizations be AI ready— specifically, how to modernize data architecture and cloud compute power to deliver responsible and sustainable AI solutions

  • Demonstrate executive presence; can immediately establish credibility with executives and additional stakeholders

  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to work under tight deadlines and produce high-quality deliverables

  • Excellent communicator who can explain complex concepts concisely and simply.

  • Superb written and verbal proficiency, analytical and presentation skills; ability to engage clients and respond effectively to questions.

  • A proficiency in analyzing and synthesizing data; can effectively apply patterns and frameworks while drawing and defending conclusions to client challenges.

  • An ability to work independently, while also being intrinsically motivated to collaborate across teams and support the workflow of others, in a multicultural global team

Who are we?

At Gartner, Inc. (NYSE:IT), we guide the leaders who shape the world.

Our mission relies on expert analysis and bold ideas to deliver actionable, objective business and technology insights, helping enterprise leaders and their teams succeed with their mission-critical priorities.

Since our founding in 1979, we’ve grown to 20,000 associates globally who support over 13,000 client enterprises in ~90 countries and territories. We do important, interesting and substantive work that matters. That’s why we hire associates with the intellectual curiosity, energy and drive to want to make a difference. The bar is unapologetically high. So is the impact you can have here.

What makes Gartner a great place to work?

Our vast, virtually untapped market potential offers limitless opportunities – opportunities that may not even exist right now – for you to grow professionally and flourish personally. How far you go is driven by your passion and performance.

We hire remarkable people who collaborate and win as a team. Together, our singular, unifying goal is to deliver results for our clients.

Our teams are inclusive and composed of individuals from different geographies, cultures, religions, ethnicities, races, genders, sexual orientations, abilities and generations.

We invest in great leaders who bring out the best in you and the company, enabling us to multiply our impact and results. This is why, year after year, we are recognized worldwide as a great place to work.

At Gartner, you’ll join a company at the very center of the AI revolution. Gartner has proactive, objective guidance throughout clients’ AI journeys. We set the standard for how organizations leverage artificial intelligence to drive meaningful impact. You’ll have access to unmatched resources, expertise, and technology, and play a key role in helping Gartner and our clients innovate and grow as we leverage AI to transform business and technology landscapes.

It’s an exciting time to be at Gartner, with limitless opportunities to make a real impact, grow your skills, and build a lasting, meaningful career in a field that’s reshaping the way we operate. If you’re passionate about AI and want to be part of a team that’s guiding the leaders who shape the world, Gartner is the place for you.

Gartner offers world-class benefits, highly competitive compensation and disproportionate rewards for top performers.

In our hybrid work environment, we provide the flexibility and support for you to thrive — working virtually when it's productive to do so and getting together with colleagues in a vibrant community that is purposeful, engaging and inspiring.

At Tilt, we see a side of people that traditional lenders miss. With millions of customers worldwide, we're not just changing how people access financial products — we're creating a new credit system that backs the working, whatever they're working toward.

The Opportunity: Staff Data Platform Engineer

Tilt runs on data-driven decisions, and our Data Platform is what makes that possible. Over the last two years our team built the governed, queryable Databricks warehouse the company now operates on, plus the dbt gold layer that turns raw data into something teams can actually use. Today the company can't build models, perform analytics or measure anything without us. The job ahead isn't building the warehouse; it's scaling how we extend it so Analytics, Data Science, and app can move fast without bottlenecking on us. Every time one of those teams waits on a ticket, the whole company's decision-making slows down. Our job is to make that wait disappear.

As our Staff Data Platform Engineer, you'll be the technical lead: a senior individual contributor who sets the architecture and builds the patterns, paved roads, and self-service flows that let other teams build on the platform safely — without filing a ticket and waiting.
