Creative Director

Location: United States or Europe

Reports to: VP of Marketing

Employment type: Full-time

About Teton

Teton is building the autonomous operating system for care. Our technology gives senior living and care teams greater visibility into resident wellbeing, movement, sleep, and care delivery, helping them respond faster, work more efficiently, and provide more personalized care.

As Teton grows across the United States, United Kingdom, and Europe, we are looking for a Creative Director to define how the company shows up across every market and customer touchpoint.

The Role

The Creative Director will own Teton’s creative vision and raise the quality, consistency, and effectiveness of our brand.

You will translate complex technology, operational workflows, and customer outcomes into clear, compelling creative work. You will oversee the development of campaigns, brand systems, sales materials, digital experiences, video, events, and product storytelling, ensuring that everything Teton produces feels cohesive, distinctive, and credible.

This is a hands-on leadership role. You will set the creative direction, build the systems that allow the team to move quickly, and remain closely involved in concepting, design reviews, storytelling, and execution.

You will work closely with Marketing, Product, Sales, Customer Success, Growth, and external creative partners.

What You’ll Own

Brand and Creative Direction

  • Define and evolve Teton’s global creative direction across brand, campaigns, digital, events, video, and sales enablement.

  • Build a clear and recognizable visual identity that reflects Teton’s position as a category-defining care technology company.

  • Ensure creative work feels modern, human, credible, and appropriate for senior living and healthcare audiences.

  • Maintain consistency across regions while allowing campaigns to reflect local market needs.

  • Establish the creative principles and standards that guide all internal and external work.

Campaign Development

  • Partner with Marketing and Growth to turn campaign strategies into strong creative concepts.

  • Lead the visual and narrative development of integrated campaigns across paid media, email, social, video, webinars, reports, and events.

  • Create work that makes complex product capabilities easy to understand and connects them to real operational outcomes.

  • Develop campaign systems that can scale across formats, regions, and customer segments.

  • Review campaign performance and use results to improve future creative work.

Product and Customer Storytelling

  • Work with Product Marketing to bring Teton’s platform, workflows, and product capabilities to life.

  • Develop clear visual frameworks for explaining how Teton works and why it matters.

  • Turn customer outcomes into compelling case studies, videos, presentations, and campaign assets.

  • Ensure the creative work accurately represents the product and avoids unnecessary technical language or overstated claims.

  • Find effective ways to communicate privacy, trust, and responsible technology without relying on generic healthcare imagery.

Sales Enablement and Presentations

  • Raise the quality and consistency of Teton’s sales decks, proposals, one-pagers, case studies, and executive presentations.

  • Create modular design systems that allow Sales and Marketing to move quickly without sacrificing quality.

  • Partner with commercial teams to improve how Teton communicates value to caregivers, operators, executives, and ownership groups.

  • Review high-priority presentations and materials for major prospects, partnerships, events, and executive meetings.

  • Build templates and guidance that make core materials easier to update and reuse.

Digital and Web Experience

  • Own the creative direction of Teton’s website and other key digital experiences.

  • Partner with Marketing, Product, and Engineering to improve site structure, storytelling, and conversion.

  • Ensure the website reflects the quality and maturity of the product and company.

  • Develop a flexible digital design system that supports new campaigns, content, markets, and product launches.

  • Balance visual impact with clarity, accessibility, and performance.

Video, Photography, and Events

  • Set the creative direction for brand films, product videos, customer stories, social content, photography, and animation.

  • Develop briefs and oversee external production partners from concept through final delivery.

  • Create a consistent visual approach for conferences, webinars, executive events, and customer experiences.

  • Ensure event environments and materials reinforce Teton’s broader brand and campaign strategy.

  • Build a strong library of original visual assets that reduces reliance on generic stock imagery.

Creative Operations

  • Build an efficient creative process from briefing through review, production, and delivery.

  • Establish clear standards for prioritization, feedback, approvals, file management, and asset reuse.

  • Manage internal designers, freelancers, agencies, and production partners as the team grows.

  • Develop templates, brand guidelines, and shared asset libraries that support self-service where appropriate.

  • Balance speed and quality while protecting the team from unnecessary revisions and unclear feedback.

What Success Looks Like

In your first year, you will have:

  • Established a clear and distinctive creative direction for Teton.

  • Created greater consistency across the website, campaigns, sales materials, events, and product storytelling.

  • Improved the quality and effectiveness of Teton’s most important commercial assets.

  • Built scalable creative systems, templates, and processes that allow the company to move faster.

  • Developed a stronger library of original photography, video, customer stories, and product visuals.

  • Helped make Teton’s technology easier to understand and its value more tangible.

  • Built a trusted creative function that can challenge, guide, and support teams across the company.

What We’re Looking For

  • 10+ years of experience in brand, design, creative direction, or a related field.

  • Experience leading creative work for a technology, healthcare, enterprise software, or other complex B2B company.

  • A strong portfolio demonstrating brand systems, campaigns, digital design, presentations, and storytelling.

  • The ability to simplify complex products and ideas without making them feel generic.

  • Strong visual judgment across typography, layout, art direction, photography, motion, and digital experiences.

  • Experience directing designers, agencies, photographers, filmmakers, and other creative partners.

  • A track record of building scalable creative systems rather than producing isolated pieces of work.

  • Strong presentation and communication skills, with the confidence to explain and defend creative decisions.

  • Comfort working directly with executives and cross-functional leaders.

  • The ability to move between high-level creative direction and detailed, hands-on execution.

  • Proficient in Figma, GenAI tools and Adobe Creative Suite, including Firefly.

  • Experience with AI and generative AI tools used for creative ideation and production. A portfolio that showcases concept-driven campaigns which drive results.

  • Experience working with data and insights.

  • Experience presenting creative concepts and campaign strategies to stakeholders and collaborators at different levels.

  • Experience in senior living, healthcare, or care technology is helpful but not required.

The Person We Think Will Thrive

You are a strong creative leader who cares as much about clarity and business impact as visual quality.

You know how to build a brand that feels distinctive without becoming decorative or disconnected from the product. You are comfortable challenging weak ideas, giving clear feedback, and helping teams arrive at stronger solutions.

You are equally willing to define the creative vision, improve a presentation, review a website flow, shape a video concept, or solve a practical production problem. You bring high standards, but you also know how to create systems that help a fast-growing company move quickly.

jobs.description:
Job description

Alternative Payments is building the financial operating system for SMBs, consolidating the disconnected tech stack that holds service-based businesses back. Starting with MSPs, we've spent five years perfecting accounts receivable, and we're now expanding into accounts payable, AI-powered analytics, and beyond. We're at an inflection point: closing the loop on money movement and laying the foundation for a platform that will reshape how service businesses operate financially.

We're growing fast, thinking big, and building a global team that wants to be part of something that lasts. We believe the best solutions come from diverse perspectives, deep collaboration, and a shared obsession with customer impact. If you're energized by real problems, real customers, and real impact, we want to hear from you!

We're looking for a Product Designer with a research-first mindset, someone who thrives on untangling complex problems and grounding design decisions in evidence. This role blends deep UX research with end-to-end product design, from discovery to polished interface. You'll work closely with Product Managers, Engineers and stakeholders to build experiences that are visually refined and deeply aligned with our users' workflows and goals.

What You'll Do

  • Own the discovery process: plan and run user research including interviews, usability testing, surveys and data analysis to uncover insights and validate design decisions;

  • Define what's worth researching: frame the questions, choose the right method for each problem and keep a continuous discovery cadence running alongside delivery;

  • Synthesize findings into actionable design opportunities, and help shape the product roadmap with them;

  • Build and maintain a shared research repository so insights compound over time and stay accessible across the team;

  • Design intuitive, accessible and aesthetically consistent interfaces for web applications;

  • Own design work from low-fidelity wireframes to high-fidelity prototypes, ensuring pixel-perfect implementation;

  • Partner with engineers during implementation to maintain design quality and fidelity;

  • Collaborate with Product Managers to define scope, requirements and success metrics for features;

  • Present design concepts, research findings and rationale to stakeholders with clarity and confidence.

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of professional experience as a Product Designer, UX/UI Designer or similar role;

  • Hands-on experience leading UX research end-to-end, from study design and recruiting to synthesis and sharing results;

  • Fluency across qualitative and quantitative methods, and good judgment about which one a given question actually calls for;

  • Strong portfolio demonstrating problem solving skills, attention to detail and the ability to design complex workflows;

  • Proficiency with Figma (or similar tools) for design, prototyping and collaboration;

  • Understanding of accessibility principles and best practices in design;

  • Ability to communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical audiences;

  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, collaborative, remote-first environment.

Nice to Have

  • Comfort turning ideas into working front-end prototypes, whether hand-coded or built with AI-assisted tools;

  • Fluency using AI as part of your process more broadly: accelerating exploration, generating and testing concepts faster, supporting research synthesis, and cutting the time between question and answer;

  • Experience designing for B2B SaaS platforms or fintech products;

  • Experience working with payment products or teams;

  • Knowledge of behavioral design or cognitive psychology principles.

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary tailored to your experience, skills, and expertise.

    • The total compensation range for this role is 60k -84k USD, plus equity. The range displayed on each job posting reflects the approximate total target compensation for the position. Within the range, individual pay is determined by factors including relevant skills, experience, education/training.

  • Equity opportunities so you can share in our growth and success.

  • Unlimited PTO and flexibility when you need it the most.

  • Yearly learning & development stipend to help you grow and do your best work.

Why Choose Alternative Payments?

At Alternative Payments, you’ll do work that truly matters.

  • Own your impact: Lead meaningful, high-impact projects and collaborative initiatives that are shaping the future of FinTech and redefining how businesses get paid.

  • Collaborate: Work with a diverse, innovative team where every voice is heard and great ideas come from anywhere.

  • Grow with us: Your career journey is top of mind. We prioritize internal growth and give you the space to shape your path based on your goals — whether that’s deepening your expertise in your domain or exploring something new.

  • Thrive in a supportive culture: As a scaling start-up, there’s a lot to be done and initiative is key. We believe in shared learning, open communication, and building each other up. When one of us grows, we all do.

Want to see what we're actually building?

We made a short video so you don't have to take our word for it. Get a glimpse of our product, our people, and the problems we're solving, then decide if it sounds like your kind of place.

Our Values

  • Transparency & Honesty: We communicate openly and truthfully with partners, investors, and each other so everyone understands where we stand and where we’re headed.

  • Resourcefulness & AI: We stay scrappy, find creative solutions, and make progress even when the path isn’t obvious. We have a bias for action and seek out the information and resources necessary to make decisions and move quickly.

  • Partnership: We win and lose together. We collaborate with our partners, investors, and teammates to tackle big challenges and reach shared goals.

  • Revolutionary & Boldness: We challenge conventions, take calculated risks, and build better, stronger solutions that move our business and the industry forward.

  • Accountability: We take ownership of our decisions and results. We follow through on our commitments knowing our work directly impacts our partners, our team and our business.

Applying to Alternative Payments

We’re looking for candidates who are ready to step in and make an impact from day one. We know that sometimes people hold back unless they meet every requirement, but if you’re excited about the role, bring relevant experience, and are ready to contribute, we want to hear from you!

All resumes are reviewed by our small but mighty talent team. While we may use AI tools to help prioritize applications, real people are behind every resume review and hiring decision. We’re also committed to an inclusive and accessible process. If you require reasonable accommodation during the hiring process, please let us know upon being selected to interview.

Position Title: Quality Assurance Registered Nurse (QA-RN)

We are seeking a Quality Assurance Registered Nurse (QA-RN) to ensure high-quality patient care by monitoring clinical practices, reviewing medical records for accuracy and compliance, and supporting continuous improvement efforts. This role conducts audits, tracks performance metrics, and collaborates with healthcare teams to maintain regulatory compliance, patient safety, and efficient care delivery.

What You’ll Do:

  • Evaluate patient records, treatment plans, and documentation for accuracy and completeness

  • Identify risks, care gaps, and inefficiencies, and recommend actionable improvements

  • Ensure compliance with healthcare regulations (HIPAA, CMS, OSHA) and organizational standards

  • Provide feedback, coaching, and training to staff on documentation, compliance, and best practices

  • Assist in resolving patient concerns, scheduling conflicts, and care coordination issues

  • Support audit readiness and regulatory inspections through accurate documentation and reporting

  • Lead or contribute to continuous quality improvement initiatives to enhance care delivery and operational efficiency

What We’re Looking For:

  • Registered Nurse (RN) with a valid, active nursing license. A Bachelor of Science in Nursing (BSN) is preferred.

  • Minimum of 3-5 years of clinical experience in nursing or healthcare settings. Prior experience in quality assurance, clinical auditing, or healthcare management is highly preferred.

  • Strong knowledge of clinical best practices, healthcare regulations, and quality assurance processes.

  • Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to work collaboratively across teams.

  • Proficiency in electronic health records (EHR) systems and healthcare scheduling software.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with the capacity to assess clinical performance and recommend improvements.

  • Ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities in a fast-paced healthcare environment.

  • Detail-oriented with a commitment to maintaining accuracy in patient records and clinical documentation.

  • Ability to maintain confidentiality and manage sensitive patient information in compliance with HIPAA and other privacy regulations.

  • Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to interact with healthcare providers, patients, and administrative teams in a professional and collaborative manner.

  • Certification in quality assurance, clinical auditing, or healthcare management (e.g., Certified Professional in Healthcare Quality – CPHQ).

  • Participate in the development and review of clinical protocols and procedures to ensure they align with industry standards and regulatory requirements.

  • Stay informed on the latest healthcare trends, regulations, and technologies that may impact patient care and quality assurance processes.

  • Lead or participate in meetings to discuss patient care improvement initiatives and implement actionable strategies to enhance clinical operations.

Why You’ll Love Joining the CO Fam!

Here’s what’s in store for you:

Health and Welfare Benefits: HMO with prescription coverage, SSS, PhilHealth, Pag-IBIG, 13th-month pay, retirement benefits, and more.

Beyond Work: Enjoy our in-office swimming pool (lowkey flex!), CO Club gaming lounge, CSR involvement through CO Stars, scholarship programs, and access to CO Academy for growth.

Travel Opportunities: We send at least 20 staff per year to visit our clients in the US, UK, and Australia, giving you international exposure and experience.

Leave Benefits: Paid holidays, Earned PTO on your first month, Wellness leave (no questions asked), plus special leaves like bereavement, parental leave, and Magna Carta leave.

Extra Perks: Salary loans up to PHP 1M (via BPI), CO Swag Bag, birthday and anniversary tokens, and our COol & flexible workplace.

Growth and Recognition: Yearly performance appraisals, career advancement programs, CO League events, and guidance from our amazing Coaches!

ABOUT THE ROLE

Byte&Kite is a digital marketing agency helping clients across a range of industries grow through effective branding, creative and digital marketing. As a Graphic Designer, you will produce brand and campaign design across multiple client accounts, including digital ads, landing pages, social assets, pitch decks and occasional brand systems. You will work from written briefs with limited art direction, taking ownership of the creative process from initial concept through production-ready delivery.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Develop creative concepts and visual directions based on client briefs, campaign goals and target audiences

  • Design campaign assets across digital, social and print for multiple client accounts

  • Create and adapt layouts for different formats, platforms and channels while maintaining visual consistency

  • Maintain and extend client brand systems, including typography, colour, imagery and graphic elements

  • Design landing pages, digital ads, social media assets, presentations and other marketing materials

  • Work from written briefs, asking the right questions before starting rather than after

  • Collaborate with copywriters, marketers, developers and other creative team members to bring campaigns to life

  • Present and defend design decisions directly to clients, explaining the thinking behind your creative choices

  • Incorporate client and internal feedback while protecting the overall quality and effectiveness of the design

  • Manage multiple projects and deadlines across different client accounts

  • Scope and estimate your own work, and flag when a brief will not fit the time available

  • Prepare and hand off production-ready files to developers, media buyers and other stakeholders

  • Keep design files organised and maintain consistent naming, versioning and asset management practices

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

  • 3+ years of professional graphic design experience, ideally in an agency or fast-paced in-house environment

  • A strong portfolio demonstrating work across multiple brands, industries, formats and marketing channels

  • Strong understanding of composition, typography, colour, hierarchy, spacing and visual storytelling

  • Ability to translate a written brief and business objective into a clear and effective visual concept

  • Experience designing for digital marketing, including social media, paid advertising, landing pages and presentations

  • Strong working knowledge of Figma and Adobe Creative Cloud, particularly Photoshop and Illustrator

  • Ability to maintain and work within existing brand guidelines while knowing when and how to evolve them

  • Comfortable working with limited art direction and taking ownership of the design process from concept to final delivery

  • Able to articulate the reasoning behind a design decision and connect creative choices to the client's goals

  • Strong attention to detail and ability to spot inconsistencies before work reaches the client

  • Comfortable managing multiple projects and priorities while meeting deadlines

  • Able to receive, interpret and implement client feedback without losing sight of the original brief and design objectives

  • Clear communicator who is comfortable presenting creative work directly to clients and collaborating with cross-functional teams

NICE TO HAVE

Motion design; brand identity and visual system development; illustration; web and landing page design; experience designing for digital advertising and social media; and familiarity with Webflow or similar web design tools.

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS

Competitive compensation based on experience and qualifications, with the full package discussed during the interview process. Professional development and training opportunities. Fully remote across US time zones, with additional company benefits discussed during the interview process.

HIRING PROCESS

Application review - 30-minute conversation - paid practical exercise - discussion of your work with the team - offer.

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY

Byte&Kite is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic. If you need an accommodation at any stage of the process, contact our recruiting team and we will arrange it.

Seven Starling is a leading virtual provider of women's behavioral health services supporting every stage of their reproductive health. Seven Starling's holistic clinical model combines specialized therapy, peer support, and medication management to effectively treat common perinatal mood disorders like postpartum depression and anxiety, with 94% of patients seeing a clinically significant improvement in their symptoms after completing the program. Seven Starling partners with OBGYN clinics across the country and leading health plans including UnitedHealthCare, Cigna, Blue Cross Blue Shield, and Aetna to make care easily accessible and affordable.
Seven Starling is looking for a Part-Time Mental Health Provider to add to its world-class therapist team. You will work with Seven Starling’s clinical and leadership team to consistently deliver a high quality care experience to our patients.
Our ideal candidate is a behavioral health professional with an interest in women's reproductive mental health. You’ll excel in this role if you are excited about working at an early stage company, pioneering the future of women’s mental health, and are motivated by the broad impact that you will have in your role!

What you'll do

  • As a Seven Starling Therapist, you'll provide compassionate, evidence-based care through teletherapy, for women navigating their reproductive journeys.
  • This is a part‑time, exempt, salaried position:

  • Schedule Expectations:

    • Total calendar availability: 29 hours open per week
    • Actual patient sessions: Approximately 20-21 completed sessions per week with at least 5 open slots after 4pm
    • The difference accounts for: No-shows, cancellations, and built-in admin time
    • Available to work during standard business hours: 8am-8pm with at least 20% of appointments being available after 4pm (approximately 5 appointments) on weekdays.
    • Participating in clinical consultation individually and in groups, and joining our monthly clinical team meeting
    • Delivering the Seven Starling Care Model by utilizing evidence-based modalities (CBT, ACT, IPT, attachment-based approaches)
    • Creating and maintaining high-quality documentation and treatment plans
    • Collaborating with a supportive clinical team in a feedback-rich environment
    • Contributing to company-wide initiatives aligned with your interests

Who you are

  • Independently licensed in NY (e.g., LCSW, LMFT, LPC, LPCC, Psychologist)
  • New York license required, with preference given to candidates who hold at least 2 additional licenses
  • At least 1 years of post-licensure clinical experience, preferably in perinatal, menopausal health or women’s mental health
  • Strong grounding in evidence-based modalities and trauma-informed care
  • Comfort and proficiency with virtual platforms, EHRs, and telehealth best practices
  • Commitment to participating in a collaborative team model with shared consultation and continuous learning
  • Passion for Seven Starling’s mission and an eagerness to contribute to a growing, dynamic company
  • This role is ideal for clinicians who thrive in a team-based environment who want to grow professionally, and are excited to help shape the future of perinatal mental health care.
  • Multi-state license is a plus
  • PMH-C a plus!

Details

  • Part-time salary position
  • Competitive salary compensation
  • Remote / Telehealth Access to team consultation, training, and professional development opportunities
  • Potential opportunities to expand hours or support company initiatives over time
  • Reimbursement for additional licenses the company may request based on patient needs
  • Paid Time Off and Sick Leave based in accordance with company policy and applicable state and local laws

Seven Starling is committed to building an inclusive, compassionate clinical team. We welcome and encourage applications from all backgrounds, identities, and experiences.

jobs.description:
Who we are

Worldline helps businesses of all shapes and sizes to accelerate their growth journey - quickly, simply, and securely. We are the innovators at the heart of the payments technology industry, shaping how the world pays and gets paid. Our technology powers the growth of millions of businesses across 5 continents. And just as we help our customers accelerate their business, we are committed to helping our people accelerate their careers. Together, we shape the evolution.

The opportunity

We are seeking a driven and well-connected Business Development Manager to join our Digital team, based in the United States. This is a hunter role focused on originating and closing new enterprise-level merchant relationships, with a particular emphasis on merchants operating significant subscription and recurring billing models.

You will be the tip of the spear for Worldline's growth in the US market - identifying, engaging, and winning new logos by leveraging your deep payments expertise, consultative selling approach, and established network of senior merchant contacts.

This role reports to the Commercial Director and works cross-functionally with product, solutions engineering, integration, risk, and commercial teams to deliver compelling, tailored propositions to prospective clients.

Day-to-day responsibilities

New Business Acquisition

  • Own the full sales cycle from prospecting through to signed agreement for new enterprise merchant logos
  • Build and maintain a robust, qualified pipeline with accurate forecasting and disciplined CRM management
  • Develop and execute a strategic territory plan identifying high-value target merchants and clear paths to engagement

Subscription & Recurring Commerce Focus

  • Serve as a subject matter expert on the unique payments needs of subscription and recurring billing merchants
  • Articulate Worldline's value proposition around authorization optimization, retry strategies, network tokenization, account updater services, and churn reduction
  • Identify and pursue opportunities in key subscription-heavy verticals including SaaS, streaming/media, digital content, health & wellness, insurance, and membership-based services

Consultative Enterprise Sales

  • Engage C-suite executives, heads of payments, and key decision-makers through a consultative, value-driven sales approach
  • Develop tailored commercial proposals and business cases that address each merchant's specific pain points, processing requirements, and growth objectives
  • Navigate complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles with professionalism, persistence, and strategic intent

Market Intelligence & Collaboration

  • Stay current on competitive landscape, industry trends, scheme rule changes, and emerging technologies relevant to digital acquiring and recurring commerce
  • Provide market feedback to product and strategy teams to inform roadmap priorities and competitive positioning
  • Collaborate with solutions engineering, integration, and onboarding teams to ensure a seamless transition from signed deal to live merchant

Relationship & Brand Building

  • Represent Worldline at industry events, conferences, and networking forums (e.g., Money20/20, MRC, Transact)
  • Build and nurture long-term relationships that position Worldline as a trusted strategic partner, not just a vendor

Who are we looking for

We look for big thinkers. People who can drive positive change, step up and show what’s next – people with passion, can-do attitude and a hunger to learn and grow. In practice this means:

  • 5+ years of business development or enterprise sales experience in the payments, fintech, or digital commerce industry
  • Proven track record of originating and closing complex, high-value enterprise deals
  • Established network of C-suite and senior decision-maker contacts across major US and/or global merchants
  • Strong understanding of the acquiring value chain - gateway, processing, acquiring, settlement - and how each element impacts merchant outcomes
  • Deep knowledge of subscription/recurring billing payments including Card-on-File transactions, MIT/CIT classification, network tokenization, and recurring scheme mandates
  • Experience developing and presenting commercial proposals including IC++, blended, and tiered pricing models, volume commitments, and SLA frameworks
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and negotiation skills
  • Self-starter mentality with the ability to operate independently in a remote/distributed environment
  • Willingness to travel domestically and occasionally internationally as needed (estimated 20–30%)

Preferred

  • Experience selling into one or more subscription-heavy verticals (SaaS, streaming, digital media, insurance, membership services)
  • Familiarity with cross-border acquiring and multi-currency payment flows
  • Prior experience at an acquirer, PSP, or payment processor (e.g., Adyen, Stripe, Worldpay, Checkout.com, Nuvei, Fiserv, Global Payments, or similar)
  • Understanding of alternative payment methods, 3DS2/SCA, and fraud/risk management in a digital commerce context
  • Experience with CRM platforms (Salesforce preferred)

Perks & Benefits

  • Salary range: $114,000 – $120,000 + 50% bonus
  • Benefits package - comprehensive health, dental, and vision coverage; 401(k) with company match; generous PTO
  • Opportunity to play a foundational role in scaling Worldline's Digital business in the US market
  • Access to a global payments platform with broad geographic reach, deep technical capabilities, and a strong product roadmap
  • A collaborative, relationship-driven culture that values long-term partnerships - with merchants, with partners, and with each other
  • Professional development opportunities and exposure to a diverse, international organization

Shape the evolution

We are on an exciting journey towards the next frontiers of payments technology, and we look for big thinkers, people with passion, can-do attitude and a hunger to learn and grow. Here you'll work with ambitious colleagues from around the world, take on unique challenges as a team, and make a real impact on the society. With an empowering culture, strong technology and extensive training opportunities, we help you accelerate your career - wherever you decide to go. Join our global team of 18,000 innovators and shape a tomorrow that is yours to own.

Learn more about life at Worldline at jobs.worldline.com

jobs.description:
Job Type: Full Time | Location:Texas | Department: Innovation | Reporting to: Manager, VDC | Work Location Type: #remote

IREN is a vertically integrated AI Cloud provider, delivering large-scale data centers and GPU clusters for AI training and inference. IREN’s platform is underpinned by its expansive portfolio of grid-connected land and power in renewable-rich regions across North America, Europe and APAC.

Reporting to the Manager, VDC, the Electrical BIM Specialist translates IREN's corporate VDC standards into practical, discipline-level execution — interfacing directly with trade contractors, internal design teams, and external design firms on the details of VDC execution for the discipline, and ensuring lessons learned are captured and fed back into company-wide standards.

With 100% renewable energy, we build, own and operate our data centers and take pride in being at the forefront of sustainable solutions for the ever-evolving applications of high-performance compute. We believe that human progress is invaluable, but it should be done in the right way – responsibly, sustainably and having a positive impact on the communities we operate in.

Responsibilities

Discipline Requirements & Workflows
  • Establish and maintain the discipline-specific BIM requirements for electrical systems — including medium- and low-voltage power distribution, switchgear, UPS, generators, busway, cable tray, grounding, and lighting: modeling standards, level-of-development (LOD) expectations by project phase, content and family libraries, parameter and classification schemes, and model quality checklists.
  • Define the discipline coordination workflow — how models are authored, exchanged, federated, clash-tested, and signed off — and document it in playbooks and templates that project teams and external partners can execute consistently.
  • Review and continuously improve these requirements based on project feedback, working with the other discipline BIM Specialists to keep cross-discipline interfaces, shared parameters, and coordination priorities aligned.
VDC Execution & Model Coordination
  • Perform and lead discipline model reviews across projects — validating model quality, completeness, and constructability for substations and switchgear lineups, generator plants, UPS and battery systems, busway and cable tray runs, panelboards, grounding systems, and lighting and controls infrastructure.
  • Drive discipline-level clash detection and resolution, with particular focus on routing busway and cable tray through congested corridors and white space, maintaining working clearances per code around electrical equipment, and resolving interfaces with mechanical systems and structural framing.
  • Support fabrication-level modeling for prefabrication and modular construction — establishing requirements for prefabricated electrical room modules, skid-mounted equipment, and busway or tray assemblies so off-site manufacturing partners can build directly from coordinated model data.
  • Participate in project coordination meetings as the discipline authority, resolving technical modeling questions and setting the quality bar for what well-executed discipline VDC looks like at IREN.
Trade Contractor & Design Team Interface
  • Serve as the primary discipline point of contact for trade contractors, internal design teams, and external design firms on VDC execution details — onboarding partners to IREN's discipline requirements, reviewing their BIM execution capabilities, and holding their deliverables to standard.
  • Audit incoming discipline models from partners for compliance with IREN requirements, providing structured feedback and working through corrections before models enter federated coordination.
Standards Stewardship & Lessons Learned
  • Capture lessons learned from each project phase — recurring clash patterns, modeling gaps, workflow friction — and convert them into updates to discipline standards, content libraries, and playbooks maintained across the business.
  • Contribute discipline expertise to corporate VDC initiatives led by the Manager, VDC, including technology evaluations, CDE workflows, and integration of model data with downstream systems.

Requirements

  • Minimum 5+ years of experience in BIM/VDC coordination or design of electrical power distribution systems in data center, mission-critical, or heavy industrial environments — familiarity with NEC working clearance and equipment access requirements is essential.
  • Expert proficiency with Revit MEP and Navisworks; experience with electrical design or calculation tools (e.g., ETAP, SKM) and prefabrication workflows is strongly preferred.
  • Demonstrated experience developing or enforcing discipline BIM standards, content libraries, and coordination workflows across multiple projects or partner organizations.
  • Strong understanding of construction sequencing, prefabrication, and field installation practices for the discipline, with the ability to judge model constructability — not just geometric clash-freedom.
  • Effective communicator able to work day-to-day with trade contractors, design firms, and internal engineering teams, and to hold partners accountable to standards constructively.
  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Architecture, Construction Management, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience; willingness to travel to project sites and fabrication facilities as required.

About the Global Institute

The Global Institute for Shaping a Better Future fosters global learning among people committed to reshaping education so that young people can shape a better future. By engaging practitioners across borders, the GI surfaces and spreads what works, building leadership while generating new evidence, tools, and resources that accelerate collective progress toward a shared vision: that all children have the education and support to shape a better future.

  • Drive the AI and EdTech vision for the Global Institute, refining and implementing a strategy that aligns the AI Literacy & Creator Collective, the Better Future Hub, and the AI EdTech Entrepreneur Community with the GI's broader AI learning agenda.

  • Support the development of regional chapters of the AI Literacy & Creator Collective, working with network partners to extend the model into new geographies.

Facilitating Strong Network Learning

Teach For All is a global network of over 60 independent, locally led organizations and a global organization united by a commitment to developing collective leadership to ensure all children can fulfill their potential. jobs.excerpt: Role OverviewPearson Virtual Schools operates learning platforms that serve schools, teachers, and students at enterprise scale, and we are actively rebuilding parts of our technology foundation to be more resilient, secure, and cloud-native.
jobs.description:
Role Overview

Pearson Virtual Schools operates learning platforms that serve schools, teachers, and students at enterprise scale, and we are actively rebuilding parts of our technology foundation to be more resilient, secure, and cloud-native. This work sits at the intersection of high-velocity product delivery and the governance expectations of a large, regulated enterprise.

As our Principal Enterprise Architect, you lead transformative architectural initiatives for our core platforms, orchestrating large-scale changes that improve performance, security, and interoperability. You balance strategic planning with hands-on technical execution: guiding teams through detailed designs, leading complex integrations, and making the calls that reduce legacy dependencies and technical risk. Your influence extends to cross-functional steering committees and project boards, where your technical judgment shapes the prioritization of multi-year platform investments.

This is not an ivory-tower architecture role. You will spend real time on designs, code, and incident retrospectives alongside engineering teams, bringing the pragmatic, ship-and-learn instincts of a high-growth startup to an enterprise setting that has to get security, compliance, and reliability right.

Key Responsibilities

Architecture Strategy & Enterprise Modernization

  • Define the north-star technical architecture for PVS's core platforms, aligning business strategy with modern, sustainable cloud topologies.

  • Lead the migration and refactoring of legacy, monolithic, or on-premise systems into decoupled, cloud-native architectures.

  • Own multi-year modernization roadmaps that balance pragmatic delivery with long-term platform health, sequencing initiatives for measurable reductions in legacy dependencies.

  • Present architectural strategy and trade-offs to cross-functional steering committees and project boards, driving alignment and prioritization on platform investment.

Cloud-Native, Event-Driven & API Patterns

  • Design systems for elastic, demand-driven scaling, including workloads that scale to zero when idle and scale out based on real-time queue depth.

  • Architect loosely coupled, event-driven integrations using message brokers and event streams, applying saga patterns to manage complex distributed transactions.

  • Establish API-first design discipline across REST, gRPC, and GraphQL contracts so services integrate cleanly and predictably.

  • Guide adoption of agentic and autonomous processing patterns, including background workers, self-healing units, and AI/LLM orchestration, where they solve real platform problems.

Technical Leadership & Mentorship

  • Define, document, and champion architectural patterns and guardrails across engineering teams, ensuring consistency without stifling team-level autonomy.

  • Act as a hands-on technical leader: review designs, unblock complex integration problems, and step into implementation when a team needs it, not just diagrams.

  • Mentor senior engineers and architects on modern cloud patterns, distributed-systems trade-offs, and pragmatic sequencing of technical debt versus new investment.

  • Model a bias for action, bringing an iterative, ship-and-learn mindset while operating within enterprise governance and risk expectations.

Cross-Functional Partnership & Governance

  • Serve as a trusted advisor to engineering & product leaders and executive stakeholders, translating architectural decisions into business impact, risk, and cost.

  • Partner with cybersecurity, data governance, and compliance teams to ensure architectural decisions meet enterprise security and regulatory standards.

  • Evaluate vendor platforms and build-vs-buy decisions, weighing cost, resilience, and integration complexity.

  • Track and report on architecture health: uptime, IT service levels, integration risk, and adoption of modern patterns across business platforms.

Preferred Qualifications

  • 10+ years of software engineering and systems architecture experience, with demonstrated progression into enterprise-scale architecture roles.

  • Significant tenure at fast-growing, internet-based startups, with firsthand experience building under constraints, scaling rapidly, and making pragmatic trade-offs.

  • Proven track record modernizing legacy, on-premise, or monolithic enterprise systems into cloud-native architectures.

  • Deep expertise with at least one major cloud provider (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and the foundational patterns that make cloud services resilient and cost-effective.

  • Hands-on experience with event-driven and asynchronous integration: message brokers, event streams (e.g., Kafka, RabbitMQ, AWS EventBridge), and saga patterns for distributed transactions.

  • Strong discipline in API-first design (REST, gRPC, GraphQL) as the contract layer between services.

  • Experience with containerization and orchestration (Kubernetes, serverless container environments) at production scale.

  • Familiarity with agentic workflows, background/autonomous processing, and modern AI/LLM orchestration patterns.

  • Exceptional communication skills, comfortable pitching architectural vision to executive stakeholders and debugging distributed-systems issues with senior engineers in the same week.

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent; advanced degree a plus.

  • EdTech, SaaS, or K-12 platform experience a plus, not required.

Key Behaviors & Attributes

Transformation-Minded: You treat legacy complexity as an opportunity, not a threat, and lead teams into modernization with conviction and empathy.

Bias Toward Action: You bring the ship-fast instincts of a startup into an enterprise setting - pragmatic trade-offs over perfect designs, without cutting corners on risk.

Strategic and Grounded: You translate a multi-year architecture strategy into concrete, sequenced technical decisions that teams can actually execute.

Hands-On by Default: You stay close to the code and the design reviews - this is a working architect role, not a diagrams-only role.

Trusted Advisor: You move fluidly between a C-suite architecture pitch and a debugging session on an asynchronous race condition, and both audiences trust your judgment.

Collaborative by Default: You build guardrails and patterns with engineering teams, not for them, so adoption sticks without heavy-handed enforcement.

Key Relationships

Direct Reports: None — individual contributor role; sets technical direction and mentors senior engineers and architects across teams

Peers: Lead, Solution Architecture; Lead, Service Operations & Cyber Risk; other senior technical leaders within Platform & Security

Cross-functional: Engineering, Product Management, Security, Data Governance, and DevSecOps teams across PVS

External: Cloud and vendor platform partners, Pearson corporate technology

Pearson is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status.

Please submit your CV in English and indicate your level of English proficiency.

Mindrift connects specialists with project-based AI opportunities for leading tech companies, focused on testing, evaluating, and improving AI systems. Participation is project-based, not permanent employment.What this opportunity involves:
We're building a dataset to evaluate AI coding agents - how well a model handles real-world developer tasks.

You'll create challenging tasks and evaluation criteria within realistic simulated environments:

  • Build realistic developer environments - a virtual company with codebase, infrastructure, and context (tickets, docs, conversations) that forms a believable development history
  • Design tasks from intermediate states of these environments - craft the prompt, define what "solved" means, and ensure the task is solvable by an AI agent
  • Write tests that verify agent solutions - accept all valid approaches and reject incorrect ones, neither too strict nor too lenient
  • Iterate on tasks and tests based on QA feedback - review agent solutions, analyze failures, and refine until the evaluation is fair and robust

What this is NOT:

  • Not data labeling
  • Not prompt engineering
  • Not writing code from scratch - the agent writes most of the code; you guide and evaluate

What we look for:

  • 8+ years in software development
  • Core stack: Python (FastAPI), JavaScript/TypeScript (React), Docker, Postgres, Kafka, Redis
  • Experience writing tests (functional, integration)
  • English proficiency - B2+

Why this is hard:
Frontier models are already good at coding. Creating a task that genuinely challenges the best models is non-trivial. You need to deeply understand where models fail and what scenarios reveal the difference between a good and a bad solution. Tasks have many valid solutions - writing tests that accept all correct solutions and reject incorrect ones is harder than it sounds.

Apply → Pass qualification(s) → Join a project → Complete tasks → Get paidEffort estimate

Tasks for this project are estimated to take 30 hours to complete, depending on complexity. This is an estimate and not a schedule requirement; you choose when and how to work. Tasks must be submitted by the deadline and meet the listed acceptance criteria to be accepted.

jobs.excerpt: FICO (NYSE: FICO)is a leading global analytics software company, helping businesses in 100+ countries make better decisions.
jobs.description:
FICO (NYSE: FICO)is a leading global analytics software company, helping businesses in 100+ countries make better decisions. Join our world-class team today and fulfill your career potential!

The Opportunity

Come join our engineering organisation to build the discipline that lets AI coding agents do reliable work at scale. As agents take on more of the software lifecycle, the hard part is no longer writing code - agents generate it faster than humans can review it, so the bottleneck shifts to verification and trust. Harness Engineering exists to break that bottleneck: engineering the environment that steers agents toward correct, maintainable, well-architected output so that quality is enforced by the system, not re-audited by a person on every change. We call that environment the harness (Agent = Model + Harness), and we're building a dedicated Harness Engineering team to own it. This is a hands-on leadership role: you will personally design and build harness components while leading and growing a regional team of harness engineers, and setting the quality bar for AI-assisted engineering across the organisation.

What You’ll Contribute

  • Personally design, build, and evolve the harness - the guides, feedback loops, guardrails, and shared context that turn raw model capability into production-grade engineering. This is a hands-on role; you will contribute code, not just direct it.
  • Build and maintain feedforward guides (agent instruction files, reusable skills, architectural rules, reference docs, and codemods) that help agents get it right the first time, and drive their adoption across teams.
  • Build feedback sensors - custom linters, structural and architecture-fitness tests, verification loops, and LLM-as-judge reviewers - that catch issues automatically before they reach human reviewers.
  • Own AI governance for your region: define authority boundaries for what agents may merge unaided, establish LLM testing infrastructure, and ensure AI-generated output meets quality, safety, and compliance thresholds before release.
  • Define and own cross-organizational QA and quality-gating standards, ensuring consistent, enforceable engineering practices across teams and product areas.
  • Run the steering loop at scale - when agents repeat a class of mistake, ensure a control is engineered so it cannot happen again - and treat repository knowledge (docs, specs, context) as the system of record, fighting drift continuously.
  • Decide where each control runs in the path to production - fast checks pre-commit, more expensive checks post-integration, and continuous sensors that scan for drift outside the change lifecycle - keeping quality as far left as is economical.
  • Establish observability into agent work and own the measures that matter - cost per merged PR, time-to-merge for agent-assisted PRs, review velocity relative to PR size, defect escape rate, and agent-PR survival rate - using them to direct where the team invests next.
  • Manage, coach, and grow a geographically distributed team of harness engineers; partner with stakeholders to attract talent, set goals, and measure and reward performance.
  • Work closely with other engineering leaders and product management to turn specifications and acceptance criteria into enforceable controls, and to align the harness with platform and delivery roadmaps.
  • Demonstrate expertise through internal enablement, presentations, and thought leadership on agent-augmented engineering.

What We’re Seeking

  • Bachelor's/Master's in Computer Science or related discipline, or relevant commercial experience in software architecture, design, development, and testing.
  • Strong software engineering background with experience in large, complex codebases, and genuine care for architecture, testing, and maintainability - you remain hands-on.
  • Hands-on experience with AI coding agents (e.g. Claude Code, Codex, or similar) and a well-developed feel for where they succeed and fail.
  • Experience building engineering tooling across a modern stack - linters and static analysis, CI/CD pipelines, containerized build/test environments, and instrumentation/observability - plus familiarity with agent instruction conventions such as AGENTS.md.
  • Experience with spec-driven development, context engineering, agent orchestration, fitness functions, and developer-platform work.
  • A systems mindset - you'd rather fix the environment than fix one output - and the ability to encode "what good looks like" into mechanical, repeatable rules.
  • Judgement about when to reach for deterministic, computational controls (type checkers, linters, structural/architecture-fitness tests) versus inferential, LLM-based ones (AI code review, LLM-as-judge) - and an understanding of the cost, speed, and reliability trade-offs between them.
  • Demonstrated experience owning AI governance and cross-organisational quality standards, including establishing LLM testing infrastructure and quality gating for AI-generated artifacts.
  • Working knowledge of the security surface unique to autonomous agents - prompt injection, tool/permission scoping, sandboxed execution, and audit trails for agent actions - and how to design least-privilege guardrails around them.
  • Strong experience managing geographically distributed, high-performing engineering teams, including navigating the organisational change that AI adoption brings.
  • Excellent communication skills to articulate design, strategy, and standards across teams.

Our Offer to You

  • An inclusive culture strongly reflecting our core values: Act Like an Owner, Delight Our Customers and Earn the Respect of Others.
  • The opportunity to make an impact and develop professionally by leveraging your unique strengths and participating in valuable learning experiences.
  • Highly competitive compensation, benefits and rewards programs that encourage you to bring your best every day and be recognized for doing so.
  • An engaging, people-first work environment offering work/life balance, employee resource groups, and social events to promote interaction and camaraderie.

Why Make a Move to FICO?

At FICO, you can develop your career with a leading organization in one of the fastest-growing fields in technology today – Big Data analytics. You’ll play a part in our commitment to help businesses use data to improve every choice they make, using advances in artificial intelligence, machine learning, optimization, and much more.

FICO makes a real difference in the way businesses operate worldwide:

• Credit Scoring — FICO® Scores are used by 90 of the top 100 US lenders.

• Fraud Detection and Security — 4 billion payment cards globally are protected by FICO fraud systems.

• Lending — 3/4 of US mortgages are approved using the FICO Score.

Global trends toward digital transformation have created tremendous demand for FICO’s solutions, placing us among the world’s top 100 software companies by revenue. We help many of the world’s largest banks, insurers, retailers, telecommunications providers and other firms reach a new level of success. Our success is dependent on really talented people – just like you – who thrive on the collaboration and innovation that’s nurtured by a diverse and inclusive environment. We’ll provide the support you need, while ensuring you have the freedom to develop your skills and grow your career. Join FICO and help change the way business thinks!

Learn more about how you can fulfil your potential at

We are Decoded. We're the pioneers of transformative digital learning. We make change possible for those committed to bettering their business by embracing technology. We use the intelligent, ethical and creative application of technology to lay the foundations for a more productive and promising world – one with unlimited possibilities.

You will sit within the Technical Solutions function, reporting to the Head of Technical Solutions. You will be a primary architect and builder of bespoke software engineering programmes for our most ambitious clients.

You will work confidently with client Engineering Leads and Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) to craft solutions that elevate software capabilities across diverse tech stacks. You are a practitioner at heart—someone who loves writing clean code, exploring new languages, and demonstrating how modern tools (like AI Copilots) are reshaping the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC).

As a Software Solutions Consultant, you are expected to be a polyglot programmer: maintaining competence in multiple languages while acting as a rigorous advocate for engineering best practices, from testing to deployment. You will take technical learning concepts from design through to a fully functional, code-validated pilot.

Accountabilities:

  • Software Curriculum Design: Partner with clients to design high-impact software engineering academies and upskilling journeys.

  • Technical Mastery: Maintain deep technical competence across the full SDLC and multiple programming languages.

  • Modern Engineering Practices: Champion the use of AI coding assistants (e.g., Claude) and robust testing methodologies in all learning solutions.

  • Content Engineering: Build, test, and deploy code repositories and technical challenges for client pilots.

  • Infrastructure & Tooling: Ensure the development environments for learners are seamless, modern, and robust.

SPECIFIC ROLE & RESPONSIBILITIES

Software Curriculum Design

  • Partner with client SMEs to develop bespoke designs for software engineering programmes (e.g., re-skilling into Java/C# or upskilling in Full Stack development).

  • Advise clients on modern software trends and the best route to develop engineering talent, balancing foundational theory with practical application.

  • Translate complex engineering requirements (e.g., Microservices architecture, CI/CD pipelines) into accessible, hands-on learning outcomes.

Subject Matter Expertise (SDLC & AI)

  • Be a hands-on practitioner in two or more core languages: C#, Java, JavaScript/TypeScript, or Python.

  • Act as a thought leader on the impact of AI on software development, demonstrating expertise in using AI coding assistants (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Cursor) to accelerate delivery; and any other major emerging trends in software development.

  • Champion best practices in software quality, including Test Driven Development (TDD), automated testing frameworks, and secure coding standards.

Content Engineering & Incubation

  • Quickly develop and deploy prototype codebases, hackathons, and technical workshops for urgent customer needs.

  • Deliver the first version ("Alpha") of technical programmes, ensuring all code examples are production-grade and pedagogically sound.

  • Support the medium-term and long-term stabilisation of software engineering programmes into resellable products.

  • Build and maintain "Gold Standard" repositories for learning exercises, ensuring they remain up-to-date with the latest language versions and library dependencies.

  • Support the handover of mature designs into the Product team for scale-up.

Infrastructure & Developer Experience

  • Work with IT Ops to configure learner environments, whether local (VS Code setups) or cloud-based (GitHub Codespaces, cloud sandboxes).

  • Support IT Ops in any occasional software development or system automation tasks that arise within their team.

  • Support the tooling requirements for your solutions, ensuring learners have access to the necessary CI/CD pipelines, container registries, or cloud platforms.

  • Troubleshoot environment issues during live pilots to ensure a smooth developer experience for learners.

BAU Support & Delivery

  • From time-to-time, deliver standard Business As Usual (BAU) software workshops and programmes when capacity requires it.

  • Act as a technical escalation point for the Product team when maintaining existing software curriculums.

Requirements

Who are you?

  • You are an experienced software engineer or developer with a passion for education and mentorship.

  • You have demonstrable proficiency in at least two of the following languages: C#, Java, JavaScript/TypeScript, Python.

  • You have deep practical knowledge of the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC), including version control (Git), CI/CD, and testing strategies.

  • You are an expert user of AI Coding Assistants (e.g., GitHub Copilot) and can demonstrate how they fit into a modern developer's workflow.

  • You understand software architecture patterns (e.g., MVC, Microservices, RESTful APIs).

  • You are comfortable advising stakeholders on technical training needs and can stand your ground on technical best practices.

Skills & Behaviours

Your performance will be measured by and driven by a mindset built on:

  • Engineering Excellence: You refuse to ship "broken" code; you care about code quality, readability, and structure.

  • Polyglot Curiosity: You are not tied to one stack; you are willing to jump between Java, C#, Typescript, Python as client needs dictate.

  • Pragmatic Problem Solving: You find the smartest, most efficient way to solve a technical challenge.

  • Collaborative Teaching: You can explain why a piece of code works, not just how to write it.

Day-to-day

Our working hours are 9 am to 5 pm, Monday to Friday (UK time). You plan your working day around the best outcomes for success, identifying and prioritising projects against business needs.

As we work with clients across different time zones, there may occasionally be times when you need to be flexible, for example, delivering a session for a US-based client might mean finishing later in the evening. When this happens, you're encouraged to adjust your hours, such as starting later that day or the next, to support a healthy work-life balance. We will endeavour to provide as much notice as is reasonably possible and discuss this with you in advance of any prolonged requirements. In these cases, you will be entitled to flexibility around working time to ensure adequate rest breaks

You will be in control and responsible for your time. You plan your working day around the best outcomes for success, identifying and prioritising projects against business needs.

Learning & Progression

All team members gain full exposure to Decoded learning programmes. So when it comes to future-proofing your CV, you couldn’t be better placed. Beyond that, we run a dedicated learning calendar to hone craft skills in leadership, management, strategy and other relevant disciplines.

Quarterly reviews embedded within our culture of feedback will ensure you are recognised and rewarded for the value that you bring to Decoded.

Apart from the above, working at Decoded means you’ll get:

  • 33 days’ holiday per year, inclusive of the 8 bank holidays. We also close for two full weeks at Christmas, at Decoded's discretion

  • Company pension contributions

  • Private health care including dental, GP, hospital cover and a gym-discount to help you prioritise your wellbeing

  • Flexible working and working from home when you need to

  • Cutting edge software and kit, always

Title: Lead Substation Physical Engineer

This position is fully remote and can only be performed from your home office within [Ontario or Saskatchewan] province(s).

Ready to make a difference?
ICF is seeking an experienced Substation Physical Engineer to lead the design and execution of high-voltage substation projects (typically 69kV to 500kV) with the goal of providing excellent quality work for our clients.

We are a relentlessly client-focused group who are re-imagining, re-designing, and re-engineering the way electric utilities tackle industry problems. We are seeking passionate and innovative people who are constantly looking for ways to provide better quality engineering services for our clients.

The Ideal Candidate

You are a highly motivated engineer who takes pride in the services you provide. You ensure the project is done right and all deadlines are met. You should be proactive, self-sufficient, and able to productively work out of your home without direct supervision.

This role requires a deep understanding of physical layout, bus design, equipment selection, grounding, and constructability. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience with utility clients, be self-motivated, and capable of mentoring junior staff.

**This position offers a clear growth path to becoming a Supervising Engineer, with increasing responsibility for project oversight, client engagement, and team leadership.**

What you will be doing:

  • Mentor and guide junior engineers and designers

  • Demonstrate leadership potential to support transition into a Supervising Engineer

  • Professional Engineer (PE) license or ability to obtain within 6 months

  • Proficiency in AutoCAD, MicroStation, or similar design tool

jobs.description:
Our Client, an international e-commerce company with a strong presence in the USA, is seeking a highly experienced and proactive Customer Service Manager to lead and scale its remote Customer Care team.

This is a full-time remote position for a hands-on leader who can build efficient customer support operations, manage and mentor a team of Customer Care Specialists, and ensure an exceptional end-to-end customer experience in a direct-to-consumer e-commerce environment.

About the company

The company is dedicated to transforming family fun with innovative and safety-first trampolines. Founded by parents, for parents, its mission is to craft high-quality trampolines that bring joy and peace of mind to families everywhere.

As a direct-to-consumer brand with its own logistics and delivery network, the company places a strong emphasis on customer education, post-purchase support, and technical assistance related to product assembly and installation. Exceptional customer service is a core value, supported by comprehensive warranties, including natural disaster protection.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives in building structured processes, enjoys improving systems, and has deep experience supporting technically complex, self-assembly products in e-commerce.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead, manage, and mentor a remote team of Customer Care Specialists.
  • Design, implement, and continuously improve customer service workflows, policies, and SOPs.
  • Own the full customer support lifecycle: pre-sale questions, order management, shipping issues, delivery coordination, warranties, returns, and post-installation support.
  • Build and optimize processes for handling technical support cases related to product assembly, missing or damaged parts, and installation challenges.
  • Act as an escalation point for complex, sensitive, or high-priority customer issues.
  • Collaborate closely with Operations, Logistics, Warehouse, and Product teams to resolve delivery and technical issues efficiently.
  • Monitor team performance using KPIs (issue resolution time, ticket backlog, quality scores, etc.) and implement improvements.
  • Ensure accurate and consistent CRM usage, reporting, and documentation across the team.
  • Identify recurring customer issues and proactively suggest product, documentation, or process improvements.
  • Train the team on communication standards, de-escalation techniques, and technical product knowledge.
  • Represent the customer voice internally and advocate for an excellent customer experience at all levels.

Requirements

  • Proven experience as a Customer Service Manager / Customer Support Manager in e-commerce.
  • Mandatory experience with direct-to-consumer brands that manage their own shipping and delivery.
  • Strong background in technical customer support for products that require home assembly or installation (e.g., furniture, fitness equipment, electronics, outdoor equipment, etc.).
  • Demonstrated ability to build, document, and scale customer service processes and systems.
  • Previous people management experience (leading, coaching, and developing support teams).
  • Fluent English with strong verbal and written communication skills (US market).
  • Deep understanding of CRM platforms, ticketing systems, and call management tools.
  • Highly organized, analytical, and process-driven mindset.
  • Calm, empathetic leader with excellent problem-solving and decision-making skills.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, growing e-commerce environment.

Nice to Have

  • Experience working with Amazon FBM Company
  • Experience working with warranty claims and replacement parts processes.
  • Experience scaling customer support teams in growing startups.

Our Benefits

  • Work for a market-proven, fast-growing e-commerce company.
  • Competitive salary based on experience.
  • Fully remote work.
  • High level of ownership and influence over customer service operations.
  • Supportive, collaborative work environment.
  • Opportunity to build and lead a customer service system with real impact.

jobs.excerpt: DescriptionThe Statistical Programmer will be responsible for the development, maintenance, and validation of annotated Case Report Forms (aCRFs) as well as of specifications and statistical programming of Standard Data Tabulation Model (SDTM) datasets, Analysis Data Model (ADaM) datasets (or derived datasets, as applicable), and Tables, Listings, and Figures (TLFs) required for various purposes including, but not limited to, Data Monitoring Committee (DMC) data review meetings, Interim Analyses (IAs), and Clinical Study Reports (CSR).
jobs.description:
Description

The Statistical Programmer will be responsible for the development, maintenance, and validation of annotated Case Report Forms (aCRFs) as well as of specifications and statistical programming of Standard Data Tabulation Model (SDTM) datasets, Analysis Data Model (ADaM) datasets (or derived datasets, as applicable), and Tables, Listings, and Figures (TLFs) required for various purposes including, but not limited to, Data Monitoring Committee (DMC) data review meetings, Interim Analyses (IAs), and Clinical Study Reports (CSR). The Statistical Programmer will also support Data Management (DM) with data cleaning activities, use global SAS macros and participate to internal initiatives to increase efficiency of the statistical programming of SDTMs, ADaMs, derived datasets, and TFLs, and use Pinnacle 21 to validate SDTMs and ADaMs.

The Statistical Programmer will work collaboratively within Biostatistical study teams and across departments to produce deliverables of the highest quality possible, within agreed timelines and budget, and in conformance with applicable International Council for Harmonization (ICH) guidelines, Pharmaceutical Industry standards and guidelines, Regulatory Authority requirements and guidelines, and Innovaderm’ standard operating procedures (SOPs) and processes.

More specifically, the Statistical Programmer must:

  • Adhere and promote company organizational values and related expected behaviors, follow company SOPs and processes for all deliverables, and ensure all trainings assigned to oneself are completed on time.
  • Review the statistical programming scope of work and budget at initiation of clinical trials and identify tasks that are out of scope.
  • Support DM with data cleaning activities by programming, reporting, reviewing, and closing statistical data issues in collaboration with other Statistical Programmers and Lead Biostatistician.
  • Develop/maintain/validate (as applicable) annotated Case Report Forms (aCRFs) according to protocol, electronic Case Report Forms (eCRF), and Innovaderm and/or Sponsor' standards and interpretation of Clinical Data Interchange Standards Consortium (CDISC) SDTM Implementation Guideline (IG) and Controlled Terminology (CT).
  • Develop/maintain/validate (as applicable) specifications and Primary or QC statistical programming (as applicable) of SDTMs, ADaMs (or derived datasets, as applicable), and TLFs based on protocol, aCRF, SAP, TLF Shells, Innovaderm and/or Sponsor's standards and interpretation of CDISC SDTM IG, ADaM IG, and CT and address any finding appropriately in collaboration with Statistical Programmer counterpart and/or Lead Biostatistician (as applicable).
  • Develop/maintain/validate (as applicable) SDTM define.XML/.PDF, clinical SDTM Reviewer’ Guide (cSDRG), ADaMs define.XML/.PDF, and ADaM Reviewer’ Guide (ADRG) based on SDTM specifications, ADaM specifications, and Innovaderm and/or Sponsor' standards and interpretation of CDISC.
  • Define guidelines and address any finding appropriately in collaboration with Statistical Programmer counterpart and/or Lead Biostatistician (as applicable).
  • Validate SDTMs, ADaMs, and define.XMLs using Pinnacle 21 and address any finding appropriately in collaboration with Statistical Programmer counterpart and/or Lead Biostatistician (as applicable).
  • Use global SAS macros to increase efficiency of the statistical programming of SDTMs, ADaMs, derived datasets, and TFLs.
  • Participate to internal initiatives to increase efficiency and/or quality of Statistical Programming activities/deliverables, including but not limited to development/ improvement/validation of standard macros, templates, and programming standards and processes.
  • Keep oneself abreast with latest Industry and CDISC standards as well as ICH and Regulatory Authority guidance and requirements.

May also:

  • Review and provide input into various DM documents (e.g., electronic Case Report Forms [eCRF], edit checks, etc.), Statistical Analysis Plans (SAPs), and Table, Listing, and Figure (TLF) Shells.
  • Act as a Lead Statistical Programmer on single studies.
  • Employee may be assigned to other responsibilities that do not pertain to their former description, if they have the required experience, are qualified and/or have received adequate training.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Statistics, Computing Sciences or a related field; master’s degree an asset.
  • At least 1 year of clinical research experience in biotechnology, pharmaceutical or CRO industry, including 1 year of Statistical Programming
  • Significant exposure to clinical trial data, SAP, TLF Shells, and specifications.
  • Excellent working knowledge of SAS; SAS certification an asset.
  • Knowledge of XML programming an asset.
  • Good knowledge of CDISC standards and guideline; CDISC certification an asset.
  • Good knowledge of drug development process, ICH guideline (including but not limited to, ICH E6, E9, and E9(R1)), relevant Health Canada (HC) and Food and Drug Administration (FDA) regulations, guidelines, and electronic data submission requirements, and Pharmaceutical Industry Good Programming Practices (GPP).
  • Very organized and detail-oriented, with effective project planning and time management skills.
  • Ability to work in high-speed environment with proven agility to juggle and prioritize multiple competitive demands.
  • Must be able to work independently and as part of a team.

Strong verbal and written communication skills in English; French an asset.

Our company

At Indero, formely Innovaderm, you will work with brilliant and driven colleagues. Our values are collaboration, innovation, reliability and responsiveness. We offer a stimulating work environment and attractive advancement opportunities.

As a Statistical Programmer, you will be eligible for the following perks:

  • Permanent full-time position
  • Flexible schedule
  • Home-based position
  • Ongoing learning and development

Work location

The successful candidate for this position is given to work remotely anywhere in Canada.

About Indero, formely Innovaderm

Indero, formely Innovaderm is a contract research organization (CRO) specialized in dermatology. Since its beginnings in 2000, our organization has benefited from a solid reputation for the quality of its research and services exceeding the expectations of its clients. Based in Montreal, Indero, formely Innovaderm continues to grow and expand in North America and Europe.

Indero, formely Innovaderm is committed to providing equitable treatment and equal opportunity to all individuals. As such, Indero, formely Innovaderm will provide accommodations throughout the recruitment and selection process to applicants with disabilities, upon request.

Indero, formely Innovaderm only accepts applicants who can legally work in Canada
